title: Talent Coordinator | Influencer Marketing & Brand Partnerships
description:
Talent Coordinator | Influencer Marketing & Brand Partnerships



Company: Lucious Management

Website: 

Location: Remote — Philippines

Employment Type: Full-Time Freelance / Independent Contractor

Monthly Compensation: $200–$250 USD + Performance-Based Commission

Working Schedule: Monday–Friday, 1:00 PM–9:00 PM Eastern Time (New York, USA)

Hours: 40 hours per week

Payment Method: Wise (Preferred) 



⸻



About Lucious Management



Lucious management is a growing talent management agency specializing in beauty, fashion, and lifestyle content creators and influencers.



We represent digital creators and help them secure paid brand partnerships, build professional relationships with brands, and develop long-term opportunities within the influencer marketing industry.



Our agency operates through its official online presence at 
, with our team handling day-to-day brand and partnership correspondence through our Lucious Talent business
, accessible at partnerships AT 



We are currently expanding our team and looking for a second reliable, detail-oriented, and proactive Talent Coordinator to work alongside our existing Talent Coordinator, AJ.



This is an opportunity to join a growing agency, work directly with an established talent coordination team, and contribute to the development and commercial success of our creator roster.



Position Overview



The Talent Coordinator will support the agency’s daily operations, primarily focusing on brand outreach, pitching, follow-ups, campaign coordination, and administrative organization.



You will work collaboratively with our existing Talent Coordinator, AJ, and report to the Founder & Head of Talent.



We are looking for someone who can manage assigned responsibilities independently, communicate effectively with international brands, and maintain consistent productivity throughout their scheduled working hours.



This position requires someone who takes initiative rather than waiting for instructions for every individual task.



Key Responsibilities



1. Brand Outreach & Partnership Pitching



* Research and identify brands that align with our creators’ niches, audiences, aesthetics, and interests.

* Pitch creators to beauty, skincare, cosmetics, fashion, clothing, accessories, footwear, lifestyle, and other relevant brands.

* Contact brand representatives, influencer marketing managers, PR agencies, and partnership departments.

* Prepare and send professional, personalized brand outreach
s.

* Conduct follow-ups with brands according to assigned outreach schedules.

* Maintain accurate records of all pitches, responses, and potential opportunities.

* Identify opportunities for paid collaborations, events, PR campaigns, gifting, and other relevant partnerships.

* Prioritize paid collaborations while identifying worthwhile opportunities for our creators.



2.
 & Inbox Management



* Organize creator-specific
 accounts.

* Maintain appropriate
 labels and folders.

* Categorize brand responses, partnership inquiries, affiliate opportunities, invoices, contracts, and campaign correspondence.

* Monitor incoming
s and promptly identify important brand responses.

* Keep inboxes organized and ensure no important partnership opportunities are overlooked.

* Maintain monthly pitching and outreach organization.



3. Campaign & Partnership Coordination



* Track ongoing brand campaigns and partnership deadlines.

* Assist with campaign scheduling and creator calendars.

* Monitor deliverables, posting deadlines, campaign requirements, and follow-up obligations.

* Request campaign briefs, budgets, timelines, and licensing information from brands when necessary.

* Communicate important campaign updates to the Founder & Head of Talent.

* Assist with coordinating creators, editors, and approved vendors.



4. Contract Review & Administrative Support



* Review draft campaign agreements and identify unusual or unfavorable terms.

* Prepare suggested edits and redlines based on agency instructions.

* Flag concerns involving usage rights, licensing, exclusivity, paid advertising, whitelisting, Spark Ads, raw footage, deliverables, and payment terms.

* Organize signed agreements and relevant campaign documentation.

* Assist with maintaining agency records and internal databases.



Important: This position does not have independent authority to accept brand deals, sign contracts, approve final campaign terms, or independently negotiate rates without written authorization.



All final deal approvals and creator representation decisions remain with the Founder & Head of Talent.



5. Team Coordination



* Work directly with the existing Talent Coordinator, AJ.

* Coordinate assigned responsibilities and avoid duplicating outreach.

* Communicate progress, outstanding assignments, and important updates.

* Participate in internal coordination and follow established agency procedures.

* Maintain organized handovers when assignments require collaboration.



Daily Work Schedule & Expectations



The required schedule is:



Monday through Friday



* Start: 1:00 PM Eastern Time (New York, USA).

* End: 9:00 PM Eastern Time (New York, USA).

* Weekly schedule: 40 hours.



Applicants must be able to consistently work according to New York’s Eastern Time, including daylight-saving-time changes.



This is not a flexible-hours position. Applicants must be available during the specified schedule.



Coordinators are expected to complete their assigned daily responsibilities, maintain accurate records, and communicate any outstanding work before the end of their shift.



Assignments must not simply be abandoned or left without an update when the scheduled shift ends. If an urgent task requires additional time, the coordinator must communicate with management and obtain approval for any additional working hours. Any additional work and compensation will be handled in accordance with the agreed arrangement and applicable law.



Performance Expectations & Pitching Standards



We value quality, consistency, and actual results over simply sending large quantities of
s.



Our general outreach planning range is approximately 100–150 targeted opportunities per assigned creator per month, depending on the roster, workload, creator preferences, and available opportunities.



The maximum general planning limit is 200 opportunities per creator per month unless otherwise approved.



We expect:



* Professional and personalized outreach.

* Accurate spelling, grammar, and creator information.

* Appropriate brand and creator matching.

* Consistent follow-ups.

* Proper tracking of outreach.

* Timely responses to brand inquiries.

* Initiative in identifying new partnership opportunities.

* No fabricated analytics, rates, or creator information.



AI Policy



We do not permit AI-generated or AI-assisted brand pitching or outreach.



Every pitch must be individually written, thoughtfully personalized, and reviewed by the coordinator before sending. We want genuine human communication, not generic automated messages.



Compensation & Commission Structure



Monthly Compensation: $200–$250 USD



The final monthly rate will depend on qualifications, relevant experience, communication skills, demonstrated performance, and overall suitability for the position.



Compensation is performance-oriented.



We expect coordinators to consistently complete their responsibilities and demonstrate meaningful contributions to the agency’s pitching and partnership efforts.



Performance reviews may consider:



* Quality and quantity of targeted pitches.

* Successful brand responses and conversions.

* Paid partnerships directly generated through the coordinator’s outreach.

* Consistency of follow-ups.

* Organization and reliability.

* Overall contribution to creator growth and agency operations.



Where performance consistently falls below reasonable expectations, compensation may be reviewed prospectively, with any agreed adjustment documented in writing and subject to applicable law. Earned compensation will not be retroactively reduced.



Additional 5% Commission



Coordinators are eligible to receive an additional 5% of the actual agency commission received from qualifying brand deals they personally source through their original pitches and meaningful follow-up.



For clarity, this is NOT 5% of the creator’s gross campaign payment.



Example:



* Creator’s brand deal: $2,000.

* Agency commission (20%): $400.

* Coordinator’s commission (5% of agency commission): $20.



The bonus is only applicable when the coordinator’s original pitch directly results in a qualifying paid partnership, the creator accepts the opportunity, management approves it, and the agency actually receives its commission.



Gifted-only collaborations, unpaid opportunities, canceled deals, and previously active opportunities do not qualify.



Payment Methods



Our preferred payment method is Wise, as it allows us to maintain organized international payment records and documentation.



We can also accommodate:



* GCash.

* Another mutually agreed payment method in exceptional circumstances.



All payments are denominated in USD, with the agreed receiving method and applicable transaction fees discussed before payment.



Professional Requirements & Confidentiality



Because this position involves access to creator accounts, brand contacts, private campaign information, and agency operations, confidentiality is essential.



The successful applicant must:



* Protect all agency and creator information.

* Never share account credentials or grant unauthorized access.

* Never use creator information or brand contacts for personal business or another agency.

* Never solicit our represented creators for independent representation.

* Never bypass management or redirect agency opportunities.

* Disclose potential conflicts of interest involving other talent agencies or influencer management businesses.

* Follow agency communication and account-security procedures.

* Maintain professional communication with brands, creators, and team members.



This is a non-exclusive freelance opportunity, subject to disclosure of potential conflicts and confidentiality requirements.



Qualifications



Our ideal applicant should have:



1. Excellent written and spoken English.

2. Strong professional
 communication skills.

3. Experience in influencer marketing, virtual assistance, talent coordination, PR, brand outreach, or digital marketing.

4. Familiarity with Gmail and Google Workspace.

5. Strong organizational and time-management skills.

6. Ability to research brands and identify relevant partnership contacts.

7. Attention to detail, particularly with names, deliverables, rates, and campaign information.

8. Ability to work independently and collaborate with another coordinator.

9. Reliable internet connection and a suitable computer.

10. Ability to work consistently during the required Eastern Time schedule.



Experience working with influencers, content creators, talent agencies, or brand partnership campaigns is strongly preferred.



Interview & Selection Process



Our current Talent Coordinator, AJ, will participate in the interview and evaluation process.



The selection process may include:



* An initial application review.

* An interview with AJ.

* An assessment of written English and professional communication.

* A practical brand research and pitching exercise.

* An evaluation of organizational skills and attention to detail.

* A final interview or approval by the Founder & Head of Talent.



We are specifically looking for someone who can work well with our existing coordinator and contribute to a collaborative, organized team.



Trial Period & Engagement



The selected applicant will be subject to a 30-day paid trial period.



During this period, we will evaluate reliability, communication, pitching quality, productivity, attention to detail, confidentiality, and overall compatibility with our team.



Continued engagement will be governed by the Talent Coordinator Agreement provided to the successful applicant.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your full name and current location in the Philippines.

2. Your relevant work experience.

3. Any previous experience with influencer marketing, brand pitching, PR, or talent coordination.

4. Your familiarity with Gmail, Google Workspace, and campaign management.

5. Confirmation that you can work Monday–Friday, 1:00 PM–9:00 PM Eastern Time.

6. Confirmation that you are comfortable with the $200–$250 USD monthly compensation range and performance-based commission structure.

7. Your preferred payment method (Wise or GCash).

8. A short explanation of why you believe you would be a good fit for Lucious Talent.



Please include the phrase “LUCIOUS TALENT COORDINATOR” in your application so we know you have carefully read the entire job posting.



We are looking for someone dependable, ambitious, detail-oriented, and interested in growing alongside an expanding talent management agency.



We look forward to meeting you!

title: Lead Documentary Video Editor
description:
About James Bowens Media



James Bowens Media is a U.S.-based travel documentary and digital storytelling brand operating under Engaging Media Group, LLC.



Our mission is to tell compelling human stories through cinematic visuals, authentic experiences, and thoughtful storytelling.



We explore people, cultures, extraordinary journeys, and stories that challenge perceptions.



We're Looking for a Storyteller



We are seeking an experienced, creative, and dependable Lead Documentary Video Editor based in the Philippines to help transform raw travel footage into compelling, narrative-driven YouTube documentaries.



We're not looking for someone who simply adds transitions, background music, and flashy effects.



We're looking for a storyteller who understands narrative structure, emotional pacing, tension, character development, and audience retention.



The ideal candidate can independently identify compelling stories within unscripted footage and take creative ownership of the editing process while collaborating with the filmmaker.



Your Responsibilities



- Edit cinematic, long-form travel documentaries for YouTube.

- Transform raw footage into engaging narratives with strong opening hooks, story progression, and satisfying conclusions.

- Select and organize interviews, dialogue, narration, B-roll, and natural sound.

- Develop pacing that keeps audiences engaged without sacrificing authenticity.

- Incorporate music, sound design, titles, motion graphics, and transitions where appropriate.

- Perform professional audio editing, color correction, and color grading.

- Work with footage from Canon cinema cameras, Blackmagic cameras, and Insta360 cameras.

- Manage large volumes of footage using organized editing workflows and proxy media when necessary.

- Collaborate on narrative direction, incorporate feedback, and complete agreed revisions.

- Deliver polished final videos and organized, editable project files.



Required Qualifications



- Currently based in the Philippines.

- Demonstrated experience editing long-form YouTube videos, documentaries, or cinematic travel content.

- Proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve.

- Strong documentary storytelling, pacing, and narrative-development skills.

- Professional audio-editing and sound-design capabilities.

- Reliable internet connection with at least 100 Mbps download speed and sufficient upload bandwidth for large media transfers.

- Strong English communication, organizational skills, and professional reliability.

- Ability to independently manage projects and meet agreed deadlines.

- A portfolio featuring relevant, completed editing projects.



Preferred Qualifications



- Experience editing travel documentaries or creator-led YouTube content.

- Familiarity with LOG footage, multicamera editing, proxy workflows, and professional color grading.

- Experience incorporating interviews, voiceovers, cinematic B-roll, and natural sound.

- Understanding of YouTube audience retention and narrative-driven editing.

- Experience with After Effects, Fusion, animated maps, or motion graphics.

- Experience collaborating remotely with international creators.



Compensation & Working Arrangement



This is a paid, remote, project-based freelance opportunity.



Compensation will be negotiated for each documentary according to scope, complexity, deliverables, and experience.

title: Short-Form UGC Video Editor (CapCut) – 15-20 Videos/Day, Fast Turnaround
description:
I run a UGC content operation making short-form videos for brands on TikTok and Instagram. I need an editor who can handle high daily volume with fast, consistent turnaround. Reliability matters more than anything else in this role.



CAPCUT ONLY: All editing must be done in CapCut. No Premiere, DaVinci, Final Cut or other software. If you don't edit in CapCut, please don't apply.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit 15-25 short-form videos per day (15-60 seconds each, vertical 9:16) from raw footage, in CapCut

- Add captions, tight cuts, pacing, music and simple effects in a TikTok-native UGC style

- Make the first second hit hard: no slow intros, no dead air

- Follow the brief and match reference videos exactly

- Deliver finished files to a shared Google Drive folder



TURNAROUND (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

- Target: within 12 hours of receiving footage

- Maximum: 24 hours, every time

- If you can't commit to this every day, please don't apply. Repeated missed deadlines end the contract.



REQUIREMENTS

- Strong CapCut skills (required, this is the only software we use)

- Proven experience editing TikTok / Reels / UGC content (portfolio required)

- Stable internet and a computer that can handle daily volume

- Clear, fast communication: reply within a few hours during your working time

- Available for ongoing daily work, not a one-off project



PAY

- $2.50 USD per finished video

- 15-25 videos/day = $37.50-$60 per day

- Paid weekly



HIRING PROCESS

2. Shortlisted candidates do a PAID trial of 3 videos at the full rate, edited in CapCut

All footage is confidential. You may not post, repost, or use any footage or finished edits in your portfolio or for other clients without written approval.

title: Virtual Assistant (US Optometry or Ophthalmology Experience)
description:
We are a U.S. based placement company. Through our specialized virtual assistant program, we train Philippine-based virtual assistants and match each one with an optometry or ophthalmology practice in the United States. This post is for virtual assistants who have already supported a U.S. eye care practice and want a long term placement with one practice, working from home as their dedicated assistant.



HOW THIS WORKS

We are the placement company, not the practice itself. If you pass screening and interviews, you complete our free eye care training (60+ hours) and earn our Virtual Assistant Certificate. We then match you with one U.S. practice. Placement depends on practice demand, so we cannot promise a start date. Paid hours begin on your first day with the practice, at $7.00 USD per hour, paid per tracked hour. You work as an independent contractor and register with the BIR once you qualify, using your own computer and internet connection. There are no application fees, placement fees or training costs at any stage.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

You support one U.S. eye care practice in one of three roles, matched to your experience.



VIRTUAL RECEPTIONIST



Answering patient calls,
s and messages

Scheduling, confirming and rescheduling appointments

Patient recalls and answering questions about eye care services



ADMINISTRATIVE SUPPORT



Verifying vision and medical insurance and gathering patient information

Updating patient chart records

Fax and file management, orders and other back office tasks



VIRTUAL SCRIBE



Live scribing during patient exams

Accurate, confidential chart documentation in the practice's EHR



WHAT WE PROVIDE



Once placed: full time hours at $7.00 USD per hour, on U.S. clinic hours (night shift in the Philippines)

A long term placement with one U.S. practice, rather than rotating between clients

Free specialized eye care training, with no fees at any stage

Fully remote work from your own home



REQUIREMENTS



Experience as a virtual assistant for a U.S. optometry or ophthalmology practice

Bachelor's degree, with proof of education

Philippine citizen, residing in the Philippines

Excellent spoken and written English

Strong computer skills and the ability to multitask across systems

A reliable computer, stable internet and a quiet home workspace

Available full time for U.S. business hours, which are night shifts in the Philippines

Highly organized, professional and patient focused



HELPFUL EXPERIENCE



Practice management and EHR systems such as RevolutionEHR, Eyefinity, OfficeMate, CrystalPM, MaximEyes or Compulink

Vision plan verification and prior authorizations with VSP, EyeMed or Davis Vision

Patient recalls, contact lens and eyeglass orders, and optical support





HOW TO APPLY

Applications are submitted on our website. To find it, search Google for "eye care works apply" and open the careers page, then choose Apply.

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter | 4 Openings | UK or US Shift
description:
Interviews: Monday, 23 November and Tuesday, 24 November 2026

Start: The day after a successful interview, beginning with a paid two-week probation period



We’re a SaaS company that helps contractors and trades businesses capture more enquiries and follow up faster. We’re hiring four outbound cold callers to join our 16-person sales team. You’ll call businesses in either the UK or US, depending on your experience, and book appointments for our sales team. The company name will be shared with successful candidates only.

What you’ll be calling about



Our introductory package is £149.99/month in the UK or US$199.99/month in the US, with no setup fee. It includes:

- A done-for-you website of up to 20 pages at no extra charge

- An AI website chatbot that answers customer enquiries

- Automated follow-up when someone submits a website form

- Missed-call text-back that follows up with callers and helps book enquiries while the owner is on a job

- Automated Google review requests that make it easier for customers to leave a review

For contractors who earn enough on a single job, one extra job can cover the annual cost of the package.

Shifts and targets

Shift Working hours

UK 12 noon–8 p.m. UK time

US 12 noon–8 p.m. US Eastern time





Each shift is 8 hours, including a 45-minute break. We provide an autodialer. You’re expected to make at least 200 outbound dials per shift and book 2 appointments per day and 10 per week. Calls are monitored, and targets may increase as performance improves.

- Two consecutive working days with zero appointments trigger a performance review.

- Three consecutive working days with zero appointments, or two consecutive weeks below the weekly target, result in dismissal.

- Log in and start calling on time. If an emergency affects your shift, notify your manager as soon as you can. Failing to start on time without appropriate notice may result in immediate dismissal.

- You may work another job if it doesn’t overlap with your shift or affect your performance.

Scheduled time off: 24–27 December 2026.

Pay



We’ll discuss base salary and commission rates with shortlisted candidates. High performers can earn US$500+ in weekly bonuses, depending on results. Salaries are paid by bank transfer on the last working day of each month.

Who we’re looking for



You speak clear, confident English, can hold a natural conversation with a business owner and stay motivated through rejection. Experience cold calling UK or US businesses is preferred. You should be comfortable with high call volumes, direct feedback and daily targets.



How to apply



Reply with a 1–2 minute Loom or video of yourself speaking in English about something you genuinely enjoy. It could be a sport, your family, your faith or a hobby. Speak in your own words so we can hear how you communicate naturally.



Include which shift you’re applying for and a short summary of your cold-calling experience. We’ll contact shortlisted applicants only.

Lead incubation means staying a kind, steady presence while families think it through. You’ll check in at the right moments, offer helpful information and make it easy to take the next step when they’re ready. Listen for what has changed, such as a new diagnosis, a hospital stay, caregiver burnout or a move, and respond with empathy

Re-qualify leads as their situations change and keep their status and notes accurate in our CRM

When a family is ready, schedule an in-home assessment for our care team and confirm every appointment (date, time, location, who will attend)

Recognize when a family has truly d
 against care, close the lead respectfully, and leave the door open

Use AI tools and our templates to keep incubation messages consistent, personal and on-brand

Send leadership a short end-of-shift update: leads contacted, families re-engaged, appointments booked and anything urgent (same day)



What You Must Have



2+ years of lead nurturing, telesales, appointment setting or inside sales experience (healthcare, senior care or home services strongly preferred)

Excellent spoken and written English: warm, clear and natural with American families

Patience and high emotional intelligence: you know when to gently encourage and when to give space

Belief in the long game. You understand that many families d
 weeks or months after their first call

Understanding of HIPAA and how to handle private health information over phone, text and

Experience with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) and a CRM

Strong attention to detail: complete, accurate notes every time

Availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours (evening/night shift in the Philippines), with a quiet, professional calling space and reliable internet



Nice to Have



Experience with A Place For Mom or similar senior-care referral leads

Familiarity with WellSky or other home care software

Experience running lead incubation, drip or win-back campaigns



Job Details



Hours: 15 hours per week, Monday–Friday, U.S. Eastern Time

Pay: $4–$7 USD per hour, based on experience

Start: ASAP

Paid trial period before long-term engagement

Signed confidentiality/HIPAA agreement required

Include a link (Google Drive, Vocaroo, Loom, etc.) to a 60–90 second audio or video recording. Imagine you’re calling a daughter who asked about care for her mother 3 weeks ago. She told us she needed to talk it over with her brother first. Introduce yourself and our agency, and show us how you’d reopen the conversation.

In 2–3 sentences, explain how you d
 when to keep incubating a lead and when to respectfully close it.

, and why.

description:
* Remote | Flexible Hours | Generous Uncapped Commissions *



Help Launch an Exciting New Trading Technology Platform!



We're preparing to launch an innovative SaaS platform designed to help forex and proprietary traders (Prop Firm Traders) protect their trading accounts, manage risk, and avoid costly rule violations.



Our software integrates with MetaTrader 5 (MT5) and provides real-time drawdown monitoring, risk and exposure tracking, behavioral alerts, performance analytics, and intelligent account monitoring.



We're looking for ambitious, self-motivated sales professionals who understand the trading industry and know how to turn opportunities into paying customers.



This is an international sales opportunity with unlimited earning potential for the right individuals.



> What You'll Do...

- Independently research and identify qualified prospects worldwide.

- Develop targeted outreach through
, LinkedIn, social media, trading communities, and professional networks.

- Connect with traders, trading academies, prop firms, brokers, educators, and other potential business partners.

- Present our software, develop relationships, and close sales.

- Explore affiliate partnerships and commercial opportunities.



**We value intelligent, research-driven outreach **



> Who We're Looking For...

- Experience in commission-based sales or independent business development.

- Familiarity with forex trading, MT5, funded accounts, and the prop trading industry.

- Strong English communication and relationship-building skills.

- A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to generate your own leads.

- Experience selling trading products, brokerage services, fintech, or SaaS solutions is a major advantage.



> What We Offer...

- Generous, uncapped commissions on successful sales.

- Recurring commission opportunities on qualifying subscriptions.

- Additional earning potential through business partnerships and commercial agreements.

- Fully remote work with flexible hours and international opportunities.

- Product training and sales support.



**This is a 100% commission-only independent contractor opportunity, with no fixed salary.** We're interested in professionals who are already comfortable working on a performance-based basis.



> How to Apply...



Please briefly answer these three questions:



1. What experience do you have selling forex, prop trading, fintech, or SaaS products?

2. Have you previously worked successfully in a commission-only sales role?

3. How would you find and approach potential customers for an MT5 trading risk-management platform for prop firm traders?



We're looking for **go-getters who create opportunities rather than wait for leads.**



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Chief of Staff- Senior Home Care
description:
About us

Seniors Helping Seniors® Mid-South Georgia is a non-medical in-home care agency serving families in Augusta, Lake Country and Macon, Georgia. Our caregivers provide companionship and personal care so seniors can stay at home. It feels "like getting a little help from your friends"™.

• Mission: To help more seniors thrive at home by providing compassionate care that feels like support from a trusted friend.

• Vision: Love in Abundance.

• Core value: Reciprocal Dignity. We honor the dignity of our caregivers as much as that of our clients.

• Our promise: The Show Up Standard™. If a caregiver calls out, we replace them with an available caregiver with a similar skill set.

We are a growing agency with a lean US-based leadership team and a remote team of virtual professionals, most of them based in the Philippines.

Role summary

The Chief of Staff runs the team's day-to-day workflow so our President/CEO can focus on growth, key relationships and strategy. You will be the CEO's right hand and the team's first point of contact. You will run the team's routine meetings, keep every project moving and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

This is a full-time remote leadership role. It reports directly to the President/CEO.

In short, you will:

• Lead the team's meetings and 1:1s in place of the CEO

• Own the team's task boards, deadlines and follow-up

• Turn the CEO's priorities into clear assignments and track them to done

• Report to the CEO each week on progress, results, risks and the decisions she needs to make

Key responsibilities

1. Team leadership and meetings

• Run the daily, weekly and 1:1 meetings listed below. Set the agenda, keep time, take notes and send action items the same day.

• Hold each team member accountable for deadlines and KPIs. Coach them when work slips, and escalate to the CEO only when needed.

• Onboard new virtual team members to our tools, standards and meeting rhythm.

2. Workflow and project management

• Own the team's task board. Every task has an owner, a due date and a status.

• Break the CEO's goals and quarterly initiatives into projects, milestones and weekly assignments.

• Spot bottlenecks and handoff gaps between teams, for example from recruiting to scheduling, or from a new client lead to onboarding.

• Write and update our standard operating procedures (SOPs) as processes change.

3. Reporting and KPIs

• Keep the weekly meeting dashboard current. It is organized by Attract Clients, Retain Clients, Attract Caregivers, Retain Caregivers and Scheduling.

• Send the CEO a one-page weekly brief covering wins, KPIs against goal, risks, open decisions and next week's priorities.

• Track our Show Up Standard™: the percent of weekly shifts filled and completed.

4. CEO support

• Act as the gatekeeper for the CEO's time. Route questions to the right person, and bring her only what needs her decision.

• Prepare the CEO for her meetings with briefs, data and talking points.

• Follow up on her commitments to partners, vendors and the team.

Who you'll lead and the meetings you'll run

You will manage the daily work of our virtual team and coordinate with our US-based staff.

Team member

What success looks like

By day 90, the CEO no longer runs the team's routine meetings, and every open task has an owner and a due date.

First 30 days: Learn our services, team, tools and KPIs. Sit in on every meeting with the CEO. Build or clean up the team's task board.

By day 60: Lead the daily scheduling meeting, the Monday staff meeting and all team 1:1s. Send the CEO's weekly brief on time every week.

By day 90: Run the full meeting rhythm on your own. Have the weekly dashboard filled in by every team lead before Monday. Have at least two new or updated SOPs in place.



How we measure you:

• Action items closed by their due date

• Weekly dashboard and CEO brief delivered on time

• Show Up Standard™ shift fill rate held or improved

• Hours of CEO time spent in routine team meetings, trending down to near zero

Requirements

• 3+ years as a Chief of Staff, Executive Assistant to a CEO, Operations Manager or Project Manager, including leading a team

• Experience managing remote teams and running meetings for US-based companies

• Excellent written and spoken English. You will speak with US staff, caregivers and partners.

• Strong with technology: Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Calendar), Zoom or Google Meet, and a project tool such as Asana, ClickUp, Trello or 

• A record of follow-through. You close loops without being reminded.

• Honest, organized and calm under pressure. You tell the CEO the truth about what is and is not getting done.

• Reliable high-speed internet, a backup power source and a quiet workspace

Nice to have:

• Experience in home care, healthcare or another service business with shift scheduling

• Familiarity with WellSky or another home care scheduling system

• Experience building KPI dashboards and writing SOPs

• Experience working for a franchise

Schedule, pay and how to apply

• Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours a week, Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM US Eastern Time (10 PM–6 AM Philippine Time)

• Pay: $5-$9 per hour, based on experience. Includes a 90-day review.

• Type: Remote, independent contractor



How to apply. Applications that skip a step will not be reviewed.

1.  Use the subject line "Chief of Staff – Show Up".

2.  Send your resume with two examples of teams or projects you managed. Include the team size, the tools you used and a result you can show with a number.

3.  Record a 3-minute video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself and explaining how you run a weekly team meeting.

4.  Answer in writing, in 200 words or less: A team member has missed the same deadline twice. The CEO asks you for an update in one hour. What do you do?

Finalists will complete a short paid work sample and a live interview. We will ask you to show proof of the experience on your resume.

title: Hiring: AI Video Editor & VFX Specialist
description:
Cali Beverages, a rapidly emerging California beverage company, is looking for a highly creative and technically skilled AI Video Editor & Visual Effects (VFX) Specialist to help produce extraordinary video content for our premium beverage brands.



----------DO NOT APPLY UNLESS YOU DO THIS NOW
PLUS YEARS EXPERIENCE ONLY. 



DO NOT WASTE OUR TIME, PLEASE



What we're looking for:



We create authentic cocktail videos featuring real people preparing and pouring drinks. We want someone who can take that original footage and transform it into cinematic, visually spectacular content using advanced AI tools and professional video editing techniques.



This is NOT a position for someone who simply generates AI videos from text prompts.



We need someone who understands how to preserve real footage while adding realistic, imaginative visual effects.



Required Technical Skills



Experience with Runway Aleph, Kling AI, Higgsfield, or comparable generative AI video tools.



Strong knowledge of video-to-video AI editing, including modifying existing footage.



Ability to add AI-generated scenery, tropical environments, flowers, fruit, lighting, animated elements, and other visual effects.



Experience with Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar professional editing software.



Knowledge of motion tracking, masking, compositing, and maintaining realistic movement.



Ability to preserve the original person, hands, glass, cocktail, liquid movement, and product branding.



Ability to create short-form social media videos and longer 1–2-minute productions.



Ability to add optional text overlays, music, transitions, and other finishing elements.



Ideal Candidate



Someone with exceptional creative instincts who understands luxury lifestyle, beverage advertising, product photography, and social media storytelling.



We want someone who can take a simple 10-second cocktail pour and turn it into something visually extraordinary.

title: Zoho CRM & Desk Developer / Integration Specialist (Project-Based)
description:
Job Type: Project-Based / Potential Long-Term Engagement

Working Hours: U.S. Time Zone (Eastern Time)

Payment: Payoneer

Time Tracking: Timeproof (Mandatory)



Job Overview



We are looking for an experienced Zoho Developer / Implementation Specialist to set up and customize Zoho CRM, Zoho Desk, and related applications and integrate them with our in-house Internal Business System (IBS).



We operate multiple restaurant brands and locations across the United States. Our goal is to build a centralized customer support and communication system with secure integrations, automated workflows, and reporting.



This is initially a project-based position. The right candidate will be considered for ongoing, long-term engagement as we continue developing and expanding our business systems.



Key Responsibilities



1. Zoho Setup & Configuration



- Set up and configure multiple Zoho CRM organizations and Zoho Desk environments.

- Configure brands, locations, users, roles, permissions, and departments.

- Implement customer support ticketing, assignment rules, and escalation workflows.

- Configure Zoho Analytics for management reporting.

- Maintain appropriate data separation between business organizations.



2. Communication & Helpdesk Integration



- Integrate Twilio for phone calls, SMS, and call routing.

- Configure customer support
, IVR, voi
, and call history.

- Automate ticket creation, notifications, follow-ups, and escalations.

- Support future integrations with WhatsApp, live chat, and AI-powered customer support.



3. Integration With Our In-House System



- Integrate Zoho with our existing web-based Internal Business System (IBS).

- Develop and configure REST API, webhook, and middleware integrations.

- Synchronize relevant customer, order, location, and ticket information.

- Enable ticket status updates, notifications, and workflow automation between systems.

- Coordinate directly with our in-house development team.



4. Automation & Reporting



- Configure workflows for customer complaints, refunds, approvals, and escalations.

- Automate ticket routing by organization, brand, location, and issue type.

- Create operational dashboards and performance reports.

- Optimize workflows for efficiency and scalability.



5. Testing & Documentation



- Perform integration testing, troubleshooting, and deployment.

- Ensure proper security, user permissions, and data protection.

- Provide technical documentation and administrator training.

- Support system improvements after implementation.



Required Skills & Experience



- Strong hands-on experience with Zoho CRM and Zoho Desk.

- Experience with Zoho Flow, Deluge scripting, Zoho APIs, and webhooks.

- Experience integrating Zoho with custom-built web applications.

- Knowledge of Twilio Voice and SMS integration.

- Proficiency in REST APIs, JSON, OAuth 2.0, and workflow automation.

- Understanding of role-based permissions and multi-organization configurations.

- Ability to work independently and coordinate with other developers.

- Good written and spoken English communication skills.



Preferred Skills



- PHP and MySQL experience.

- Zoho Analytics and Zoho SalesIQ.

- Experience with customer support and call-routing systems.

- Experience supporting multi-location or multi-brand businesses.



Work Requirements



- Must be available to work during U.S. business hours (Eastern Time).

- Must use Timeproof to track all working hours and activities. Payment for time-based work will be based on verified work records.

- Payments will be made through Payoneer according to agreed project milestones or verified working hours.

- Must provide regular progress updates and communicate with our development team.

- Must be able to deliver working solutions, not just recommendations.



Project Deliverables



1. Fully configured Zoho CRM and Zoho Desk environments.

2. Working Twilio phone/SMS integration and customer support workflows.

3. Secure API integration between Zoho and IBS.

4. Automated ticketing, routing, and escalation workflows.

5. Management dashboards and reporting.

6. Complete testing, documentation, and knowledge transfer.



Long-Term Opportunity



We are continuously developing our internal business platform and expanding our operations. Successful completion of this project may lead to ongoing work involving Zoho enhancements, API integrations, workflow automation, system maintenance, and future development projects.



How to Apply



Please provide:



1. Your experience with Zoho CRM, Zoho Desk, SalesIQ and API integrations.

2. Examples of similar projects you have completed.

3. Your experience integrating Twilio with Zoho.

4. Your estimated timeline and project-based rate or quotation.

5. Your availability to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

6. Confirmation that you agree to use Timeproof and receive payments through Payoneer.



Important: We are looking for a hands-on Zoho specialist who can independently configure, develop, integrate, test, and deliver a working system.

title: Revenue Management Assistant (Short-Term Rentals) – Full Time
description:
We're looking for a sharp revenue management assistant who learns new systems fast, is comfortable talking to clients, and can contribute from day one.



RevWhisper prices and manages listings for short-term rental owners across Airbnb, Vrbo and 
. We manage 250+ homes across the US and Canada and add 10 to 20 more every week. We're hiring full-time assistants to do hands-on pricing work and client support alongside our revenue managers.

Clients

s and texts promptly and clearly

MUST HAVE

- A track record of learning new software quickly

- Strong spreadsheet skills and attention to detail

- Reliable internet and power backup; available for your agreed shift, including weekends or nights if that's your schedule



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience supporting a revenue manager across a portfolio of homes

- Airbnb, Vrbo or 
 experience

Position Requirements:

• Personal tone: Our communications with students are FRIENDLY, FUN, and PERSONAL. It's like talking to your best friend. We use emoji's and exclamation points and are very personal. We take the opposite approach of large corporations that give robotic, frustrating, not very helpful support. You need to be intuitive and have strong emotional intelligence to feel what the students are needing when they communicate.

• More creativity: there is more freedom to adjust your responses for each scenario. This is more challenging than just following strict templates, but also more stimulating and exciting.

• Impact: your actions will have a big impact on the business, which you will clearly see

• Feedback: your feedback on what we are doing well, and what could be better, is not only valued, but is mandatory! We want everyone here thinking as if they were the business owner.

title: TikTok Shop Manager — Shop Setup + Affiliate/Influencer Campaigns (Remote)
description:
About us: Nu Dawn eCommerce is a U.S.-based agency that helps e-commerce brands sell online (Amazon, Shopify, and now TikTok Shop). We are building a TikTok Shop service for our clients and are looking for one hands-on specialist to run it.



The role: You will own TikTok Shop for our client brands, end to end:

- Set up new TikTok Shops for e-commerce brands: seller account setup, product catalog upload and optimization (titles, images, pricing, shipping templates), shop policies, and launch readiness

- Build and manage the affiliate program: find and recruit TikTok creators/affiliates who fit each brand, send outreach, negotiate commission structures, and keep affiliates active and posting

- Run affiliate onboarding end to end: make sure every affiliate signs the agreement/contract before starting, coordinate shipping free product/samples to them, and follow up until they actually post — then keep tracking who posted and who is driving sales

- Manage influencer campaigns: briefs, content deadlines, tracking which creators post and which drive sales

- Monitor shop health: orders, fulfillment issues, policy violations, account warnings — and fix problems before they become penalties

- Track performance (GMV, affiliate sales, top creators, conversion) and send a short weekly report in plain English



This is a hands-on, solo-operator role. You do the work yourself — outreach, setup, follow-ups, reporting. We are not looking for an agency, a team lead, or someone who delegates the work.



Requirements:

- Proven experience running TikTok Shop for at least one e-commerce brand (setup + ongoing management) — be ready to name the shops/brands and what you did

- Proven affiliate/creator recruitment experience on TikTok Shop: outreach volume, commission negotiation, sample management

- Understands TikTok Shop policies well enough to keep shops in good standing (no strikes/violations)

- Comfortable with spreadsheets/tracking for creator pipelines and sales

- Reliable internet, your own equipment, and availability for a weekly call during U.S. Mountain Time morning hours

- Philippines-based applicants only



Nice to have: experience with U.S. TikTok Shop (not only PH/SEA markets); experience in beauty, food, or consumer products; Shopify familiarity.



To apply: In your message, include (1) the TikTok Shops you have set up or managed, with your exact role; (2) your best affiliate campaign result — how many creators you recruited and what sales it drove; (3) how you would spend your first 30 days setting up a brand-new shop and its affiliate program. Generic copy-paste applications will be ignored.



Terms: Part-time contractor, ~20 hours/week. Pay: $5.50/hour (about $475/month at 20 hrs/week).

title: Agent Recruiter and Trainer
description:
Life & Health Insurance Agent Recruiter & Trainer

Remote – Philippines

Company: Sloan Healthcare Innovations (US-based, Evergreen, Colorado)

Position type: Full-time, remote (work from home)

Location: Philippines

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 12:00 or 1:00 PM until 6:00 or 7:00 PM Mountain Time (about 3:00/4:00 AM – 9:00/10:00 AM Philippine Time; one hour earlier in Philippine Time during US daylight saving time)

Compensation: USD TBD per month + performance bonus per contracted agent

Fluent, professional English (spoken and written) is required. You will speak directly by phone and video with licensed insurance agents in the United States every day. Applicants without strong conversational English will not be considered.

About Us

Sloan Healthcare Innovations is a US healthcare growth and distribution firm. We partner with insurance brokers, general agents, FMOs, associations, and TPAs to bring innovative health benefit solutions to market. We are growing our network of independent licensed life and health insurance agents across the United States, and we need an experienced recruiter and trainer to help us build that team.

The Role

You will recruit, onboard, and train licensed life and health insurance agents in the United States. You will manage the full recruiting pipeline — from first outreach to a signed, contracted, and appointed agent — and then lead virtual training so new agents understand our insurance products and can use our enrollment platforms with confidence. This is a phone- and video-heavy role for someone who already knows the US insurance agent world and the American health insurance market.

Key Responsibilities

1. Source agents — Build prospect lists of licensed life and health agents using LinkedIn, state licensing lookups,
 groups, industry directories, and other tools.

2. Outbound outreach — Make cold calls and send
s, texts, and LinkedIn messages to introduce our opportunity. Target: 8-10 meaningful conversations per day.

3. Qualify candidates — Confirm active state licenses, lines of authority, production history, carrier appointments, and fit with our products and markets.

4. Book appointments — Schedule qualified agents for discovery and onboarding calls with US leadership.

5. Follow up consistently — Run multi-touch follow-up sequences so no lead goes cold.

6. Support contracting and onboarding — Guide new agents through contracting paperwork, E&O and license verification, and carrier appointments.

7. Deliver virtual training — Lead live Zoom/Teams training sessions for new and existing agents on our insurance products: plan design, eligibility, benefits, pricing, and how to position them with clients.

8. Train on our enrollment platforms — Become an expert user of the quoting and enrollment platforms we use, and teach agents how to quote, enroll members, and troubleshoot common issues.

9. Build training materials — Create and maintain simple guides, checklists, FAQs, and recorded walk-throughs.

10. Manage the CRM — Log every call,
, training, and status change; keep pipeline data clean.

11. Report weekly — Calls made, conversations, appointments set, agents contracted, trainings delivered, and pipeline status.

Required Qualifications

• Fluent English — clear, confident, natural speaking voice with a neutral accent; excellent written English with correct grammar.

• Insurance license — an active US state Life & Health (A
 & Health) producer license is strongly preferred. At minimum, a current Philippine Insurance Commission life/health license or completed US pre-licensing coursework.

• 2+ years of experience recruiting insurance agents (life, health, Medicare, or annuities) for a US-based agency, IMO, FMO, or call center.

• Knowledge of the US healthcare and health insurance market — individual/family (ACA Marketplace) plans, employer group and small-business plans, self-funded and level-funded plans, Medicare basics, and life and supplemental products. Comfortable with terms like deductibles, networks, open enrollment, and special enrollment periods.

• Enrollment systems experience — hands-on use of US quoting/enrollment and benefits administration platforms (for example carrier portals, HealthSherpa, 
, Employee Navigator, Ease, bswift, or similar).

• Training ability — experience delivering virtual training on Zoom or Teams; able to explain complex insurance products and software simply.

• Proven cold-calling and appointment-setting experience with measurable results.

• Available Monday–Friday from 12:00/1:00 PM until 6:00/7:00 PM Mountain Time (Philippine early-morning shift).

• Reliable high-speed internet (minimum 25 Mbps), backup internet or power source, quiet workspace, quality headset, and webcam.

• Self-motivated, organized, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with US licensing tools and processes (NIPR, state DOI lookups, carrier contracting and appointments, E&O).

• Experience with health benefits, self-funded plans, or group/small-business insurance.

• Experience with CRMs (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or similar) and dialers (RingCentral, Kixie, Aircall, etc.).

• Experience recording training videos or tutorials (Loom, Camtasia) or using a learning management system.

• LinkedIn Sales Navigator experience.

What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

• Days 1–30: Learn our products, agent value proposition, enrollment platforms, and CRM; build a target list of licensed agents; begin daily outreach.

• Days 31–60: Consistently hit daily activity goals; book qualified appointments every week; deliver your first agent training sessions.

• Days 61–90: Deliver newly contracted agents every month, run regular product and platform trainings, and maintain a clean, reportable pipeline.

What We Offer

• Long-term, stable full-time position with a growing US company

• Competitive monthly pay plus performance bonuses for contracted agents

• Paid training on our products, platforms, and recruiting process

• Direct work with US company leadership

• Opportunity to grow into a recruiting and training team lead role

How to Apply

Please send the following. Applications missing any item will not be reviewed.

1. Your resume / CV

2. A 2-minute audio or video recording introducing yourself in English and describing your experience recruiting and training insurance agents

3. Details of any insurance licenses you hold (US state and NPN, or Philippine Insurance Commission license)

4. A short written answer (3–5 sentences): "How would you approach a licensed life insurance agent who is happy with their current upline?"

5. A list of the enrollment platforms you have used

6. Your internet speed test screenshot

7. Your expected monthly salary in USD

8. Optional: a link to a training video or tutorial you have created

Please use the subject line "Insurance Agent Recruiter & Trainer – [Your Name]".

title: Business Development & Research Assistant
description:
About ZMH Group

ZMH Group is developing relationships with organisations involved in social housing, supported living, temporary accommodation and emergency accommodation. The business wants to understand organisations’ accommodation requirements so the Director can assess potential property opportunities and partnerships.



Purpose of the role

Research relevant providers and councils, identify decision-makers, make professional introductory contact, understand and record accommodation requirements, complete follow-ups, arrange introductory appointments and maintain accurate company records.



Key responsibilities

Provider research

Identify social housing providers, supported living operators and temporary/emergency accommodation organisations. Review each organisation’s website and services before contact. Prioritise organisations whose work aligns with temporary, emergency or supported accommodation.

Council research

Identify local authorities and relevant housing, temporary accommodation, procurement, commissioning and supplier teams. Find appropriate public contact routes and procurement portals.



Outreach

Make approved introductory calls and send approved
s. Personalise contact based on research, identify the right person and ask how ZMH Group may be of value.



Requirements gathering

Record operating areas, expansion areas, property types and bedroom sizes, property condition/standards, HMO licensing requirements and rent/payment settings.

Follow-ups and appointments

Complete agreed follow-ups, record outcomes and next actions, and arrange introductory meetings for the Director.

Google Sheets, Excel Sheets and reporting

Maintain provider and council trackers, log outreach, complete a daily work log and submit a short Loom end-of-day summary.

Inbox management

Monitor the designated inbox, organise correspondence, use approved routine templates and escalate opportunities or sensitive matters.



Scope boundaries

This role is limited to providers and councils. The VA must NOT research or contact landlords, private property owners or sellers, and must NOT source properties. These activities remain with the Director unless changed by written instruction.

The VA must not promise property availability, quote or agree rents, negotiate commercial terms, confirm licensing/compliance, submit tenders, make financial commitments or sign agreements. Refer these matters to the Director.



Candidate requirements

• Excellent spoken and written English and a confident telephone manner.

• Experience in B2B research, lead generation, appointment setting or customer support.

• Confident using Google Sheets, Excel,
 and online research tools.

• Able to research organisations and identify appropriate decision-makers.

• Accurate, organised, proactive and comfortable working independently.

• Willing to maintain a daily activity log and record short Loom updates.



Working pattern and assessment

The role is 20 - 25  hours per week, normally five hours per day Monday to Friday. Agree the exact working window with the Director to provide useful overlap with UK business hours. Review performance weekly, with a 30-day assessment and any probation period set out in the written agreement.

Recruitment exercise



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to research a small sample of relevant UK providers and councils, identify the correct contact route, complete a sample requirements record and record a short Loom walkthrough.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Company Overview

An outsourced accounting and fractional CFO firm serving tech startups, service businesses, and venture-backed companies across the US. The business runs alongside a separate US entity following an acquisition, and is actively hiring on both sides. Strong US go-to-market motion, small senior team, fast pace.



Role Summary

You are the managing partner’s right hand for inbox, calendar, and keeping deals moving. This is not a passive scheduling job. You are expected to see conflicts before they happen, know who is contacting him and why, and bring solutions rather than questions.

1. The single most important thing in this role is the priority order:

2. Prospects first. Someone new reaching out is the highest priority in the business. They get booked fast.

Clients second. Existing clients come next.

3. Partnership conversations third. Valuable, but they move when something above them needs the slot.

Everything you prioritize, reschedule, or escalate follows that order. If you cannot tell which bucket something falls in, you find out.



Proactive Calendar Ownership

Read the calendar at least two weeks ahead, every week. Conflicts get caught in advance, not the night before.

Never cancel or move a meeting without checking first, including on holidays. Ask about an upcoming holiday a week out, not the morning of.

New prospect and new client meetings get booked into the soonest workable slot. People reaching out for the first time do not wait.

Build and maintain color-coding by meeting type, so priority is visible at a glance and you know what can move.

Protect focus blocks, handle buffers and travel, manage timezones across entities.

Own reschedules end to end.



Know Who’s Who

Learn the clients, prospects, partners, and team. This is a short list and it is learnable.

When an unfamiliar name appears, find out before you act: check the
 domain, check the CRM, look up the company. Ask the GTM lead or the team if it is still unclear.

“I didn’t know who it was” is not a reason to deprioritize something.

Build and keep a reference of key contacts, their category, and how they should be handled.



Inbox Ownership

Daily triage across multiple inboxes in Front. Filter FYIs, newsletters, and noise into holding areas.

Keep “Assigned to Me” limited to what genuinely needs the managing partner.

Draft replies in his voice using prior threads and templates.

Maintain clear states: Needs response, Awaiting reply, FYI, Later, Delegated.

Coordinate with teammates who tag and assign in Front so nothing stalls.



CRM and Deal Support (Pipedrive)

Your lane is clear: get the lead and the scheduled meeting into Pipedrive. The GTM lead manages the deal from there. No finger-pointing, no gaps.

Make sure follow-ups happen on time and nothing drops.

Create reminders and nudges for next steps and scheduling.

Help close the gap between AI meeting notes and the CRM so call context lands where the team can use it.



Systems Improvement (Weekly, Ongoing)

This is a standing part of the job, not an onboarding project. Every week you bring at least one concrete improvement to how the account runs. Not a list of suggestions, a change you have thought through and are ready to implement.

Every improvement is judged against two goals:

Smoother operations. Less friction in the week, and less of the managing partner’s time spent on coordination.

Easier sales flow. Prospects get booked faster, follow-ups don’t drop, and deals move without anyone chasing.



In practice:

Calendar color-coding by meeting type. This is the first one.

Message tagging so urgency is unambiguous: FYI, FNS (for next shift), URGENT.

Closing the gap between AI meeting notes and the CRM.

Templates for recurring
 types, scheduling links for common meeting types, a maintained contact reference.

Removing a step from anything you find yourself doing manually more than twice.



Document what you change. If you cannot say in one sentence which of the two goals an improvement serves, it is not the right one that week.



Working With the Internal Operations Hire

The company is adding a US-based operations person who will carry more day-to-day client and prospect detail. You are the executive-side owner: inbox, calendar, scheduling, routing, and follow-up discipline. They are the client-detail owner. You are expected to build a working rhythm with them quickly and define the handoffs rather than wait to be told.



Communication

Text is the primary channel with the managing partner. Be responsive and concise.

Use message tagging so urgency is obvious: FYI, FNS, URGENT / ACTION NEEDED.

Short daily status: what changed, what needs attention, what is blocked.

Flag problems early. Surprises are worse than bad news.



Tools

Front (primary inbox and calendar hub), Google Workspace and Microsoft, Pipedrive, Calendly, Reclaim, Slack, PandaDoc, QuickBooks (awareness only), AI drafting and notetaking tools.

title: Health & Safety Specialist – New Zealand Experience Essential (Casual / Remote)
description:
MeasureUp Flooring Ltd is a New Zealand flooring and acoustic installation business. We are looking for an experienced Health and Safety specialist to support our team remotely on a casual, as-needed basis.



IMMEDIATE PROJECT — REVIEW OUR H&S SYSTEM AND SUPPORT SITEWISE GOLD

Your initial project is to review and strengthen our existing H&S arrangements and help complete our current SiteWise assessment/renewal, with Gold as the target. We need someone who can independently establish what is in place, identify gaps and set out a practical action plan with priorities, responsibilities and due dates.



Work with management and site staff to bring documents and records up to date, gather current evidence of actual work practices, address outstanding actions, prepare the assessment submission and assist with assessor feedback. After the initial project, provide casual ongoing support to keep records, training renewals, corrective actions and assessment evidence current throughout the year.



Practical NZ H&S and contractor prequalification or audit preparation experience is essential. SiteWise experience is preferred; equivalent experience with other assessment systems will be considered. Tell us which systems you have worked with, what you personally delivered, the results and how soon you can start.



PAY AND HOURS

US$11.00 per hour. Hours will vary according to workload, with no guaranteed weekly hours. Work must be agreed in advance. You will need some availability during New Zealand business hours to communicate with management and our site teams.



NEW ZEALAND EXPERIENCE IS ESSENTIAL

You must have practical experience supporting New Zealand businesses with health and safety, preferably in construction, trades or flooring. You must understand the Health and Safety at Work Act 2015, relevant regulations and current WorkSafe New Zealand guidance, and be able to apply them to real work situations.



YOUR WORK WILL INCLUDE

- Reviewing our existing H&S systems, identifying gaps and maintaining a clear action plan with named responsibilities and due dates.

- Preparing and updating site-specific safety plans, task risk assessments, JSAs, safe work procedures and toolbox talk material.

- Assisting with SiteWise assessments, renewals and contractor prequalification submissions, using genuine records and evidence supplied by our team.

- Maintaining hazard/risk registers, i
 and near-miss records, corrective actions, training records and expiry reminders.

- Maintaining safety data sheets and hazardous-substance information.

- Helping management address risks such as concrete grinding and dust, noise, adhesives and chemicals, manual handling, hot works and work in occupied buildings.

- Following up missing information and actions with staff, and keeping H&S documents organised in Google Drive and our digital systems.



This is a remote support role working alongside our New Zealand management and site teams. On-site checks and implementation will be coordinated with the people carrying out the work. You must clearly flag anything requiring site verification or specialist advice.



YOU MUST HAVE

- Demonstrable experience with New Zealand H&S requirements and the ability to work independently.

- Strong written and spoken English, accurate document preparation and reliable follow-through.

- The ability to turn requirements into clear, practical instructions for tradespeople.

- Confidence using Google Workspace and online H&S systems. SiteWise and SiteApp Pro experience will be an advantage; practical NZ H&S and comparable prequalification/audit preparation experience are essential.

- A reliable computer and internet connection.



TO APPLY

Use “NZ SAFETY” in your application subject and include:

1. Your CV and relevant H&S qualifications.

2. Specific details of your experience supporting NZ businesses: industry, your responsibilities and how recently you did this work.

3. Your experience with SiteWise or comparable contractor prequalification/audit systems, including work you personally completed, results achieved and an example of improving an existing H&S system.

4. One redacted example of relevant work, if you are authorised to share it. Remove client names, personal information and confidential details.

5. How soon you can start, your availability during NZ business hours and confirmation that you accept US$11.00 per hour on an as-needed basis.



Please apply only if you already have the relevant New Zealand H&S knowledge and experience.

title: Client Satisfaction Coordinator
description:
About Us



Seniors Helping Seniors® Mid-South Georgia is a non-medical in-home care agency serving older adults in Augusta and Lake Country, Georgia. We are experts in companionship and also provide excellent personal care. Our mission is to help more seniors thrive at home with compassionate care that feels like support from a trusted friend. Our core value is Reciprocal Dignity: we honor our caregivers as much as the clients they serve.



We’re growing, and we want every client and family to feel known, heard and cared for from day one. That’s where you come in.



About the Role



As our Client Satisfaction Coordinator, you will be the steady, friendly voice that checks in with our clients and families. You’ll make sure every new client’s onboarding was done right, gather honest feedback, and spot early signs that a client needs a schedule change or a follow-up visit from one of our Home Care Advisors. You’ll also help us celebrate our clients by tracking birthdays and special occasions.



Key Responsibilities



Client follow-up calls: Make scheduled check-in calls to clients and family members after their service starts and at regular intervals after that.

Onboarding audit: Confirm each new client’s onboarding steps are finished, including:

The care plan is completed and on file

The client has been introduced to their caregiver(s) through caregiver bios

Any other onboarding checklist items

Satisfaction surveys: Run periodic client satisfaction surveys by phone,
 or text, then record and summarize the results.

Feedback escalation: Listen for and flag feedback that signals:

A scheduling need (more or fewer hours, a time change, a caregiver preference), which goes to our Scheduler

A change in the client’s needs or situation, which goes to our Home Care Advisors for re-engagement

Any concern that needs management attention

Celebrations and touchpoints: Keep a tracker of client birthdays, cards sent, greetings made and other special touchpoints, and make sure no one is missed.

Collection of Google Review when a client is elated with service.

Documentation: Log every contact, survey result and follow-up in our systems (WellSky, Airtable or similar) accurately and on time.

Reporting: Send a simple weekly summary of client sentiment, open issues and items you escalated.



Qualifications



Excellent spoken and written English, with a warm, clear and professional phone manner (you’ll be speaking with seniors and their adult children)

2+ years in customer service, client success or account management, ideally with US clients

Experience in healthcare, home care or senior services is a big plus

Highly organized, detail-oriented and dependable with follow-through

Comfortable with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office, CRMs or databases, and VoIP calling tools

Experience with WellSky or Airtable is a plus

Patient, empathetic and a good listener, especially with older adults who may be hard of hearing or need extra time

Discreet: you’ll handle confidential client information



Requirements



Reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection or power source

A quiet, professional workspace and a noise-canceling headset

Available Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–2:00 PM US Eastern Time (see note below)



How to Apply



Please send:



Your resume

A short voice recording (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself as if you were calling a client to check in after their first week of care

In 3–4 sentences, tell us about a time you turned an unhappy customer into a happy one



Start your application with the subject line “Reciprocal Dignity” so we know you read the full posting. Applications without it will not be reviewed.

title: Script Writer, Short-Form AI Film Series (3-minute episodes, cliffhanger format)
description:
Type of work: Full-time

Pay: Open. Send your rate per episode script with your application. Paid weekly.

Hours: Flexible, paid on output. Must answer messages for 2–3 hours during U.S. Eastern evenings.



About us

JJ Creative Films makes cinematic AI thriller and drama films for
, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. Each film is about 10 episodes, and each episode runs under 3 minutes. We post one episode every Monday through Friday, so that's 2 films a month (about 20 episodes). Each film is also released as one full movie on YouTube when it ends. All footage is generated with Seedance 2.5.



What you'll do



 • Pitch film ideas, then write a full outline for each film (about 10 episodes, through the ending) before scripting.

 • Write about 2 complete films a month (5 episode scripts a week), each episode about 2:50 on screen.

 • Every episode needs:

 • A hook inside 3 seconds. The first line is the conflict. No walking in, no setup.

 • A turn every 15–20 seconds: a reveal, a lie exposed, a new problem.

 • Short, natural dialogue that sounds like real people. Interruptions, people talking over each other, no speeches.

 • One quiet emotional moment between the fights.

 • A cliffhanger ending that opens a new question and makes people need the next episode.

 • Write for AI production:

 • Small casts.

 • Clear physical actions.

 • Scenes that break into short, achievable shots.

 • No crowds or complicated stunts unless the story needs them.

 • Track continuity: who knows what, who has which prop, where everyone is, what time and day it is.

 • Revise quickly when footage or feedback calls for changes.

 • Deliver each week's 5 scripts at least one week ahead of posting, so production has time to generate and edit.



Requirements (must have)



 • Proven experience writing short-form serialized drama: micro-dramas, Reels or TikTok series, vertical drama apps, or YouTube story channels. Regular screenwriting, articles or ad copy alone isn't enough.

 • Links to episodes you wrote that were actually posted, ideally with view counts.

 • Strong English dialogue that sounds natural to American audiences.

 • Can deliver 5 scripts a week on deadline.

 • Big plus: experience writing shot-by-shot prompts for Seedance or other AI video tools.



How to apply



 • Start your message with "CLIFFHANGER" so I know you read the whole post.

 • Your rate per episode script (about 3 minutes on screen), and whether it includes the film outline.

 • Send 2–3 links to short-form series you wrote, and tell me which episodes are yours.
