title: CALL CENTER MANAGER
description:
Remote Call Center Manager – Outbound Appointment Setting | 20-Setter Team

Sierra Roof Inc. | Philippines-based | Full-time, remote

Schedule Sunday through Friday, California Pacific Time. Saturday off on the California schedule. Applicants must be available for the corresponding overnight hours in the Philippines.

Compensation $10–$15 USD per hour, depending on experience, plus weekly and monthly performance bonuses and commission opportunities.



Sierra Roof  is an Anaheim, California roofing and exterior remodeling company. Our appointment setters book in-home estimates for our field sales team. We’re hiring a hands-on manager who can recruit, lead, and hold a remote team of 20 appointment setters accountable for the appointments our sales representatives actually run.



Apply only if you have at least five years of call center management experience and have personally managed a remote outbound appointment-setting team of at least 20 setters. You must have owned the team’s quotas, reviewed individual calls, made hiring and performance decisions, and managed appointment confirmations. In your application, we’ll ask for the size of your team, the numbers you owned, and an example of a result you improved.

What you’ll own

Recruit, hire, and train the team. Maintain a pipeline of qualified setters. Interview candidates, run live phone auditions, and make hiring decisions. Train new hires on homeowner conversations, objections, GoHighLevel, dialer use, and booking standards. Listen to their first calls and track how quickly they reach quota. When a setter consistently misses expectations, deliver direct feedback, set a measurable improvement deadline, and replace them when necessary.



Lead a morning huddle every shift. Come prepared with yesterday’s results, today’s open sales slots, and each setter’s target. Recognize strong calls, coach one specific skill, and make sure every setter starts the shift knowing which leads to work and what they’re expected to produce. Check performance again mid-shift while there is still time to correct it.



Manage every setter’s production. Review attendance, dialer activity, live contacts, appointments booked, confirmations, and appointments held. Listen to recordings from every setter each week. If someone is making calls but booking few appointments, identify where the conversation breaks down, role-play the correction, and review subsequent calls to see whether it worked. Be ready to take a live call and demonstrate the standard yourself.



Own appointment confirmation and dispatch. Every appointment must be confirmed with the homeowner before a sales rep is dispatched. Build a confirmation process with a named owner, a deadline, and a recorded outcome for every booking. Verify the date, time, property address, and purpose of the visit. A sent text or an unanswered call stays pending until the homeowner responds. Prioritize same-day appointments, flag at-risk slots early, and coordinate reschedules and replacements with sales. Our target is a 75% or higher show rate.



Control lead flow throughout the day. Monitor new inquiries and hold the team to a one-to-five-minute first-contact attempt during staffed hours. Assign callbacks, monitor overdue follow-ups, and recycle older leads into the appropriate campaigns. Keep GoHighLevel, LeadPerfection, and the sales calendar accurate so another team member can open a record and know exactly what happened and what comes next.



Report results and act on them. Send a concise end-of-day scorecard showing each setter’s goal and actual production, plus team totals for leads received, contacts, bookings, confirmations, held appointments, cancellations, and no-shows. When performance falls short, explain where the drop occurred, what you changed, and what you’ll check the next day.

Required experience

- At least five years managing call center operations, with direct responsibility for a remote outbound team of 20 or more appointment setters.

- Hands-on GoHighLevel experience managing pipelines, lead assignments, tasks, dispositions, and reporting.

- Hands-on experience with WAVV, multi-line dialers, LeadPerfection, and RingCentral. You must be able to operate the systems yourself and coach setters through them.

- Direct ownership of an appointment confirmation process, including same-day confirmations, reschedules, no-show recovery, and coordination with field sales.

- Experience recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, coaching, and replacing setters.

- Clear spoken and written English, reliable internet, a backup connection, and a quiet workspace suitable for live calls and coaching.

Experience booking U.S. residential roofing, solar, or home improvement appointments is strongly preferred.

How to apply

Use the subject line Call Center Manager | [Largest Setter Team You Managed] Setters | [Your Name]. Attach your résumé and answer the following four questions. Use actual figures where available and leave out confidential employer or customer information.

1. What was the largest remote appointment-setting team you personally managed? Give the number of active setters, how many reported directly to you, how long you led them, what they booked, and which hiring and performance decisions you owned.

2. What did your team produce in a typical week? Give the per-setter quota and the team’s booked, confirmed, and held appointment counts for the same period. Explain how you calculated show rate and describe one result you improved.

3. How did you use GoHighLevel, WAVV, LeadPerfection, and RingCentral? For each system, name one task you personally performed as the manager.

4. How would you handle this shift? It’s 8:30 a.m. California time. Four of today’s ten appointments are still unconfirmed, two setters called out, and fresh leads are arriving. Walk us through your first 30 minutes. Tell us what you handle personally, what you delegate, and when you update the sales team.

Include a 90–120 second Loom video describing one underperforming setter you managed. Tell us what you heard on their calls, what you coached, and what happened afterward. Finish by confirming your availability for the Sunday–Friday California schedule.



Shortlisted candidates will lead a five-minute mock morning huddle and coach a sample appointment-setting call. We want to hear how you set expectations, spot a missed opportunity, and show a setter what to say on the next call.

description:
# Full-Time Remote Operations Coordinator  

### Philippines-Based | Long-Term | Growth Opportunity



**Site Masters Junk Removal** is a fast-growing Tampa Bay junk removal and property cleanup company. We are hiring a long-term **Remote Operations Coordinator** to help keep our customers, technicians, trucks, schedules, estimates, invoices, and job documentation organized.

## Main Responsibilities

### Unshakable Integrity



Tell the truth, communicate early, follow through, and own mistakes.

Do not simply forward problems. Identify the next action, assign ownership, and follow up until the issue is resolved.

Learn quickly, improve constantly, and perform at a high level without needing to be chased.

title: SEO, Google Ads & Apollo Specialist Using Claude
description:
We are two small North American B2B manufacturers selling to architects, contractors and facility managers. You would split your week between both companies, working alongside a full-time teammate who already knows our SEO work.



This is a hands-on marketing role. 

You will do the real work: apply SEO changes, run Google Ads campaigns and launch Apollo outreach. 

What is different is how: we use Claude to do the heavy, time-consuming parts (audits, analysis, drafts, prospect filtering), so you spend your time on decisions and execution instead of repetitive manual work. You review what Claude produces, correct it, and are accountable for what goes live.



What you will do

- SEO: run daily and weekly audits with Claude (indexing, titles and meta descriptions, broken links, rankings in Search Console and Semrush), then make the fixes yourself in Wix and Shopify: titles, metadata, image alt text, internal links, redirects and page content. You also keep a change log.

- Google Ads: manage our Search campaigns. You use Claude to review search terms, performance and ad copy, then apply the changes yourself: negative keywords, ad text, bids and budgets, new ad groups. You track results and explain them.

- Apollo prospecting: build prospect lists, use Claude to pre-filter them, check the first contacts by hand, then set up and launch the sequences. You follow up on replies and keep Apollo and our CRM data clean.

- Reporting: write a short end-of-day report in your own words, with numbers and links, and keep our Trello board current.



Tools you will use: Claude, Google Search Console, Semrush, Google Ads, Apollo, Wix and Shopify , Google Sheets, Trello. 

You do not need to know them all. Tell us honestly what you know.



What we are looking for

- Real hands-on experience executing in at least two of these: SEO, Google Ads, B2B prospecting.

- Daily practice with Claude and the discipline to verify its output before acting on it.

- Careful, detail-oriented, and honest about what you have and have not done. Saying “I haven’t done this yet” will not disqualify you. Claiming experience you don’t have will.

- Clear written English (C2 minimum)

- Comfortable working as part of a pair, and asking questions.



Schedule and terms

Full-time, 35-40 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

Compensation: depending on experience, with reviews based on results, skills demonstrated and commitment to the project. We value long-term relationships and want to grow with the right person.

At least 4 hours of overlap with Eastern Time, and availability for early-morning Eastern Time meetings.



To apply, please answer these questions in your own words (short and specific):

- Tell us about a time Claude gave you a wrong or weak result. What was wrong, and how did you catch it?

- Describe an SEO task you did yourself in Wix or Shopify. What did you change, and how did you check the result?

- What have you personally done in Google Ads ? Which parts have you not done?

- You have 500 prospects exported from Apollo. How would you use Claude to filter them, and what would you verify manually before launching a sequence?

- For each tool, say “never”, “basic” or “used regularly”: Search Console, Semrush, Apollo, Wix, Shopify, Google Ads.

- Send us proof of your own work: a link to a portfolio, a report, or a short screen recording (Loom or similar, 3 minutes max). Show a real task you did yourself in SEO, Google Ads or Apollo, using Claude if you did. We want to see what you changed and what the result was, not a general description. Please add 2 or 3 sentences stating which parts you did personally and which parts the team or the client did. Statements like “I did SEO for a client” without a link or a concrete example will not be considered.

- Can you attend early-morning Eastern Time meetings? What is your ideal schedule, your expected rate in USD, and your earliest start date?



Applications that skip the questions or paste generic or AI-copied answers will not move forward.

description:
Are YOU an experienced customer service representative who can read the emotion behind a two-line
 and respond like a real, warm, thinking human being — not a copy-pasted bot reply? Can you handle a chargeback dispute on a digital product and actually have a shot at winning it, knowing exactly what evidence matters when there's no tracking number or delivery signature to show? If you answered an enthusiastic "YES" to both questions above, KEEP READING.

We run multiple international companies in the ecommerce and digital education space, including a growing catalog of craft and DIY digital products, selling primarily to English-speaking customers in the US, UK, EU and Australia. We're looking for a Customer Service Representative to join our support team and take full ownership of the post-purchase customer experience.

We need someone to take responsibility for:

Inbox Ownership: Handling our daily support inbox end-to-end — order access issues, missing downloads, billing questions, refund requests, and general product questions — as the friendly, reliable human voice of the brand.

Retention-First Problem Solving: Before ever processing a refund, identifying and offering the right retention or bonus-bundle offer per our SOP. A refund is always the last resort, not the first move.

Chargeback & Dispute Defense: Responding to chargebacks and payment disputes on digital products with the right evidence (delivery confirmation, access logs, communication history, terms accepted at checkout) — you understand this is a different game than physical-product disputes, and you know a genuinely high win-rate claim doesn't exist in this space.

Template Adaptation, Not Scripting: We provide a complete SOP with
 templates for every common scenario. Your job is to use them as a base and adapt the tone naturally to each customer — never robotic, never obviously AI-generated or copy-pasted.

Escalation Judgment: Knowing exactly when a situation (legal threat, unusual request outside our templates, a case that just doesn't smell right) needs to be flagged to us instead of improvised.

Daily Reporting: Keeping a simple log of ticket volume and any recurring issues you notice, so we can fix problems at the source.

Position Requirements:

At least 2 years of specific customer service experience for digital products — not physical/shipping-based ecommerce. You must know the practical difference between a refund and a chargeback, and have direct experience responding to disputes where a tracking number isn't an option.

Fluent English, 9/10 or above: natural, native-sounding phrasing — not translated-sounding sentences. Availability & Commitment: This role requires coverage 7 days a week, including Saturday and Sunday — no exceptions, no "9-to-5, Monday-Friday" mentality. Minimum 3 hours/day, structured as short check-ins spread across your day (morning / afternoon / evening, your own local time zone). Please tell us honestly: how many other clients/hours are you currently working, and would you see this growing toward full-time with us in the coming weeks or months?

Obsessive Precision & Anti-Mediocrity: correct order numbers, correct links, zero copy-paste mistakes in a customer's name or order details. Mediocrity is not allowed in our team.

What We Offer:

A complete, ready-to-use Customer Service SOP with templates for every common scenario, plus clear escalation guidelines — you'll never be guessing.

A short, paid trial period before any long-term commitment.

Career Growth: real potential to become the lead/only customer service representative across our full catalog as it expands, with performance-based rate increases and a path toward full-time.

Screening Questions (Upwork):

. Can you help?"

title: Customer Service E-commerce (Fluent English, Weekend Availability Required)
description:
Are YOU an experienced customer service representative who can read the emotion behind a two-line
 and respond like a real, warm, thinking human being — not a copy-pasted bot reply? Can you handle a chargeback dispute on a digital product and actually have a shot at winning it, knowing exactly what evidence matters when there's no tracking number or delivery signature to show? If you answered an enthusiastic "YES" to both questions above, KEEP READING.

We run multiple international companies in the ecommerce and digital education space, including a growing catalog of craft and DIY digital products, selling primarily to English-speaking customers in the US, UK, EU and Australia. We're looking for a Customer Service Representative to join our support team and take full ownership of the post-purchase customer experience.

We need someone to take responsibility for:

Inbox Ownership: Handling our daily support inbox end-to-end — order access issues, missing downloads, billing questions, refund requests, and general product questions — as the friendly, reliable human voice of the brand.

Retention-First Problem Solving: Before ever processing a refund, identifying and offering the right retention or bonus-bundle offer per our SOP. A refund is always the last resort, not the first move.

Chargeback & Dispute Defense: Responding to chargebacks and payment disputes on digital products with the right evidence (delivery confirmation, access logs, communication history, terms accepted at checkout) — you understand this is a different game than physical-product disputes, and you know a genuinely high win-rate claim doesn't exist in this space.

Template Adaptation, Not Scripting: We provide a complete SOP with
 templates for every common scenario. Your job is to use them as a base and adapt the tone naturally to each customer — never robotic, never obviously AI-generated or copy-pasted.

Escalation Judgment: Knowing exactly when a situation (legal threat, unusual request outside our templates, a case that just doesn't smell right) needs to be flagged to us instead of improvised.

Daily Reporting: Keeping a simple log of ticket volume and any recurring issues you notice, so we can fix problems at the source.

Position Requirements:

At least 2 years of specific customer service experience for digital products — not physical/shipping-based ecommerce. You must know the practical difference between a refund and a chargeback, and have direct experience responding to disputes where a tracking number isn't an option.

Fluent English, 9/10 or above: natural, native-sounding phrasing — not translated-sounding sentences. As part of the application, you'll be asked to record a short 60-second video or voice response to a question you haven't seen in advance. This isn't optional — written answers alone won't be considered.

A real thinking mind, not an AI-generated response: we will read your written answers closely, and generic, overly polished, ChatGPT-flavored replies will be filtered out immediately. We want your judgment, not a prompt's.

Comfortable with our tools: Google Drive (sharing, permissions, troubleshooting access errors), PDF delivery, and a shared support inbox/helpdesk.

Availability & Commitment: This role requires coverage 7 days a week, including Saturday and Sunday — no exceptions, no "9-to-5, Monday-Friday" mentality. Minimum 3 hours/day, structured as short check-ins spread across your day (morning / afternoon / evening, your own local time zone). Please tell us honestly: how many other clients/hours are you currently working, and would you see this growing toward full-time with us in the coming weeks or months?

Obsessive Precision & Anti-Mediocrity: correct order numbers, correct links, zero copy-paste mistakes in a customer's name or order details. Mediocrity is not allowed in our team.

What We Offer:

A complete, ready-to-use Customer Service SOP with templates for every common scenario, plus clear escalation guidelines — you'll never be guessing.

A short, paid trial period before any long-term commitment.

Career Growth: real potential to become the lead/only customer service representative across our full catalog as it expands, with performance-based rate increases and a path toward full-time.

Screening Questions (Upwork):

Please write a 3-4 sentence sample reply to this customer message: "Hi, I purchased the ebook bundle two days ago but never received the download
. Can you help?"

Have you handled disputes/chargebacks on digital products before? If so, roughly what percentage have you been able to win, and what evidence/approach did you use? (Be honest — we're checking for real experience, not a number.)

What's your current workload with other clients (hours/week), and do you see yourself moving toward full-time with us in the coming weeks or months?

This role requires 7-day-a-week availability, minimum 3 hours/day split into short check-ins across your day — not Mon-Fri only, and not one continuous block. Please confirm you're comfortable with this on an ongoing basis, and share your proposed check-in times in your own time zone.

To Apply: Include the sample reply above directly in your application, along with a brief note on your relevant experience. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for a short 60-second video or voice response before moving forward.

title: Full-Time & Part-Time Customer Care & Sales Support VA (GoHighLevel)
description:
Hi! I'm Yas of HIDARI Group, a growing Canadian business optimization and implementation company.



We’re growing our customer care team to support homeowners across Western Canada as they choose and install blinds, shades, shutters, drapery, and motorized window coverings.



I’m looking for a warm, confident and highly organized Customer Care & Sales Support VA who knows GoHighLevel (LeadConnector) and loves talking to customers on the phone.



This is NOT a CRM build or automation role. The pipelines, workflows and follow-up sequences are already set up.



I’m looking for someone who can work inside that system every day: call new leads within minutes, book in-home consultations, follow up on quotes, answer customer messages, and keep every record accurate.



You will be working directly with our office team, who will train you and be your day-to-day point of contact.

Your primary goal will be simple:



Make sure no lead, customer, quote or service request falls through the cracks, and keep the consultation calendar full.

What You’ll Be Doing



Your responsibilities will include:



- Responding to new leads, missed calls, texts and
s within 5–10 minutes

- Calling new leads to book free in-home consultations

- Collecting and entering complete booking details (contact info, service address, number of windows, budget, products of interest, preferred date and time)

- Following up with leads who haven’t booked yet

- Calling and texting customers about open quotes after their consultation

- Answering general questions and finding out what’s holding a customer back

- Managing the CRM Conversations inbox throughout your shift

- Reviewing customer history, notes and tasks before every call or message

- Updating notes, tasks and opportunity stages after every interaction

- Responding to Google reviews with professional, personalized replies

- Tracking warranty, repair and service requests until they’re resolved

- Reviewing completed installations and closing files once every checklist is done

- Escalating pricing, complaints, warranty approvals and installation issues to the office team

- Preparing a weekly report on leads, bookings, quotes and open issues



The system already sends automated follow-ups. Your job is to add the human touch: the call, the thoughtful reply, and the follow-through.



Experience We’re Looking For: 

Hands-on GoHighLevel (LeadConnector) experience is required.



Please apply only if you have used GoHighLevel day to day: managing opportunities and pipelines, working the Conversations inbox, booking into calendars, and updating contacts, notes and tasks.



We’re specifically looking for someone with experience in appointment setting, inside sales support or customer service for North American customers, ideally in home services (window coverings, roofing, HVAC, solar, renovations or similar).



We are NOT looking for someone whose only GHL experience is building funnels or automations without talking to customers.

You should have:



- Excellent spoken English with clear, warm and confident phone communication

- Excellent written English for texts,
s and review replies

- Previous experience calling customers in Canada and/or the United States

- Previous appointment-setting or sales follow-up experience

- Daily, hands-on use of GoHighLevel/LeadConnector (pipelines, Conversations, calendars, tasks, reviews, dialer)

- Enough understanding of GHL workflows to avoid double-messaging customers or triggering the wrong automation

- Ability to handle several conversations at once without missing details

- Strong attention to detail and consistent note-taking habits

- Good judgment about what you can handle and what needs escalating

- Basic Google Sheets skills for weekly reporting

- Reliable internet with a backup connection and backup power

- A quiet, professional workspace and a good-quality noise-cancelling headset



Experience with home improvement or window covering products, franchise businesses, the LeadConnector mobile app, and handling warranty or service requests is an asset.



The Person I’m Looking For



Personality matters to me.



You’ll be the voice homeowners hear when they first reach out. You’ll also be the person who makes sure they’re looked after long after their blinds are installed.



You should be friendly, patient, dependable and comfortable taking ownership. If a quote has gone quiet, I want you to follow up. If a customer mentions a problem in passing, I want you to log it and make sure someone deals with it. If a task is sitting open, I want you to close it or flag it.



I’m not looking for pushy sales tactics.



I’m looking for someone who can confidently say:

“Hi Sarah, I’m following up on the quote from your consultation last week. Did you have a chance to look it over, or are there any questions I can help with?”



From there, you should be comfortable having a real conversation, listening for what’s holding them back, and guiding them to the next step.



Hours & Position

We’re hiring for both full-time and part-time positions:



Shift

Weekdays



Mountain Time

Mon–Fri, 3:00pm–8:00pm



Philippine Time (Nov–Mar)

Tue–Sat, 6:00am–11:00am



Philippine Time (Mar–Nov)

Tue–Sat, 5:00am–10:00am



Shift

Weekends



Mountain Time

Sat–Sun, 9:00am–6:00pm



Philippine Time (Nov–Mar)

Sun–Mon, 12:00am–9:00am



Philippine Time (Mar–Nov)

Sat–Sun 11:00pm – Sun–Mon 8:00am



Philippine times move one hour earlier during North American daylight saving time.



You’ll start with 2 weeks of paid training, shadowing our office team and learning their products, policies and GoHighLevel setup. You’ll then manage the role alongside them.



The busy season runs March to August, so you’ll be fully trained and confident before the volume picks up.

This position will initially begin as a 3-month pilot, with the opportunity to become a long-term role if we’re a great fit and the position is producing results.



A confidentiality agreement and security training are required before you start.



How to Apply: 

Please don’t send me a generic application. I’d genuinely like to learn a little about you.

In your application, please answer the following:



1. How many years have you used GoHighLevel/LeadConnector, and which features did you use daily?

2. Have you called or messaged customers in Canada or the United States? Please explain what you were doing.

3. What industries have you supported (home services, real estate, healthcare, etc.)?

4. Roughly how many appointments were you booking in a typical week?

5. A customer received a quote a week ago and hasn’t replied. What would you say when you call them?

6. How would you reply to a 2-star Google review that says the installer arrived late?

7. Are you applying for the full-time or part-time position? Which shift(s) can you cover, and do you have backup internet and 

power?

8. Please include a short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you’d be good at this position.

9. Please send your updated CV or portfolio for our reference.



Applications without hands-on GoHighLevel experience will not be considered.



If you’re warm on the phone, organized in the CRM, quick to respond, and love the feeling of turning an inquiry into a booked consultation and a happy customer, I’d really like to hear from you.



Lastly, please note that we will only entertain applications submitted through our official job postings on OnlineJobs.ph. 

Thank you for your understanding.



- Yas

Reliability: customers and suppliers depend on you, so consistency matters more than anything on a CV. Starting part-time, with room to grow toward full-time.

What We Offer:



A complete Customer Service SOP with templates and escalation guidelines, so you're never guessing.

A short, paid trial period before any long-term commitment.

Real growth: more responsibility, more hours and performance-based rate increases as the role expands.

Ownership and variety: you'll work with the AI stack, build automations and see the results of your ideas inside a real, growing business.

How many years have you answered customer tickets in ecommerce? Which stores or types of products, which channels 
, chat) and which tools? Have you handled disputes/chargebacks, and on digital products, physical products or both? In your experience, how many tickets can one person realistically handle in an 8-hour day, and what does that number depend on?

title: Online Group Facilitator: Wellbeing & Connection Sessions (Zoom, Part-Time, Long-Term)
description:
Do you love deep conversations, bringing people together, and helping others feel heard?



WeSangha is a new wellness startup that brings small groups of people together on Zoom for guided conversations. Think of it like a kumustahan or recollection sharing session, but online with 2 to 6 people: sharing, listening, and reflection exercises that help people connect beyond small talk. We're looking for a warm, people-loving facilitator to host these sessions and grow with us long-term.



No special certification needed. We'll train you on the exact exercises and scripts. What matters most is who you are: kind, calm, curious about people, and genuinely interested in personal growth.



What you'll do

- Host live Zoom sessions for pairs and small groups (5–6 people), following a guided script

- Welcome participants, explain the group agreements, keep time, and guide each exercise

- Create a safe, respectful space where people feel comfortable sharing

- Gently support anyone who gets emotional and follow our safety guidelines

- Write short notes after each session on what worked and how people felt

- Help improve our exercises and test a new guided-session app we're building

- Help invite and follow up with participants



You'll be a great fit if you

- Love people and conversations that go deeper than small talk

- Stay calm and kind when someone shares something emotional

- Are on your own personal growth journey (journaling, meditation, therapy, retreats, coaching, faith-based reflection, anything)

- Speak clear, natural English and are comfortable on camera

- Are reliable, organized, and good at following a structure

- Have stable internet, a quiet space, and a laptop with a webcam

- Can work some evening or night hours (Philippine time) for international participants



Experience that helps (not required)

- Leading retreats, recollections, youth or campus ministry, or small groups (formator experience welcome)

- Kumustahan, psychosocial support, or Psychological First Aid (PFA) training

- Peer support, mental health advocacy, or community volunteering

- Psychology, guidance counseling, HR training, or coaching background

- Yoga, meditation, or mindfulness teaching

- Hosting workshops, webinars, or online communities

title: Bankruptcy Case Manager (US Law Firm) - Trustee Documents & Deadlines
description:
READ THIS FIRST

To apply, start your message with the word TRUSTEE and answer the four questions at the end. Applications that skip this get deleted unread. This job is about following instructions exactly and on time, so the application is the first test.



WHO WE ARE

Van Horn Law Group, P.A. is a bankruptcy law firm in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. We file Chapter 7 and Chapter 13 consumer and business cases in four federal court districts. About 100 people work here, including 15 attorneys. We have been doing this for over a decade and we file cases every single week.



THE JOB IN ONE SENTENCE

After we file a client's bankruptcy case, the trustee starts asking for documents on a deadline, and you are the person who makes sure every single one arrives on time.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Own a caseload of filed Chapter 7 and Chapter 13 cases from the filing date all the way to discharge.

Track every trustee document request and every court deadline on your cases. Nothing gets lost, nothing gets late.

Chase clients by
, text and phone until the documents actually arrive. Politely, persistently, and without letting anything sit.

Assemble and submit document packages to the trustees through their portals.

Get clients ready for their 341 meeting of creditors so they show up on time, with ID, knowing what to expect.

Confirm the required credit counseling and financial management courses are completed and the certificates are in the file.

Escalate to the supervising attorney the moment a deadline looks at risk. Early and often. We would much rather hear about a problem a week out than the day after.

Keep every case status current in our system so anyone can see where a file stands in ten seconds.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Follow up is the entire job. We need someone who cannot stand an open item. If a client ignores three
s, you find another way to reach them. If a document looks wrong, you catch it before the trustee does. If a deadline is six days out, it is already on your mind.

This is not a role for someone who waits to be told what to do. Cases fall apart quietly when nobody is chasing, and a missed deadline can get a client's case dismissed. That is why this job matters and why we pay well for it.

You should be comfortable being the calm, organized person telling a stressed client for the fourth time that we still need their bank statement, and having them thank you for it.



REQUIRED

At least 2 years chasing documents, payments or information from people against a deadline. US law firm, collections, insurance claims follow up, medical billing and accounts receivable, mortgage processing, or title work all count. US bankruptcy experience is a big plus but it is not required.

Excellent spoken and written English. You will be on the phone and on
 with US clients every day.

A real system for tracking deadlines. In your application, tell us what it is.

Available during US Eastern business hours.

A reliable computer, backup power, a quiet place to take calls, and stable internet of at least 25 Mbps. We will ask for a speed test screenshot.

Able to sign a confidentiality agreement and work inside our secure systems. Our clients' financial information never leaves them.



IMPORTANT ABOUT THIS ROLE

You will never give clients legal advice. You collect documents, confirm dates, explain our process, and route every legal question to an attorney. We will train you on exactly where that line sits, and we take it seriously.



NICE TO HAVE

Experience with Chapter 7 or Chapter 13 trustee document requests.

Experience with 341 meeting preparation.

Experience with a US law firm case management system.



WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive monthly salary in USD, paid on time, every time.

Paid time off plus Philippine holidays.

HMO after the probationary period.

Full paid training on US bankruptcy procedure and our systems. If you have the discipline, we will teach you the law part.

Real advancement. Our senior Philippine team members lead other people and are paid accordingly.

A long-term seat. We are hiring someone we expect to still be here in five years.



SALARY

We pay at the top of that range for someone who has done US bankruptcy post-filing work before.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word TRUSTEE. Then answer these four questions in your own words. Please do not use AI to write your answers. We read a lot of these and we can tell.

1. Describe a job where you were responsible for chasing people for documents, payments or information on a deadline. How many were you handling at once, and exactly how did you track them?

2. A client has ignored three
s and one phone call, and the document is due in four days. Walk us through exactly what you do next, step by step.

3. What tools have you used to track deadlines and case status, and what did you like or dislike about them?

4. What hours can you work in Philippine time, and are you comfortable being on the phone with US clients?

Attach your resume and tell us your expected monthly salary in USD. We reply to every applicant who follows these instructions.

title: Inbound Appointment Setter / ISA, US Roofing Leads (Full-Time, US Hours)

THE ROLE

s

- Home setup: quiet workspace, noise-canceling headset, and stable internet (25+ Mbps) with a backup connection or power source

- Bonus: experience with roofing, home services, solar, or real estate leads

WHAT YOU'LL GET

- A stable, long-term, full-time role with a US company

- Weekends off

- Hourly base pay plus a bonus for every appointment that shows

1. Put "ROOF READY" as the first line of your application

2. Attach or link a 1 to 2 minute voice recording where you introduce yourself and role-play calling a homeowner who asked about a new roof

3. Describe your US phone experience in 2 to 3 sentences: what you sold or booked, and your best result



We won't review applications that don't include the voice recording.

title: Part-Time VA – Outbound Calling, Client Follow-Up & GoHighLevel (US Home Inspections)
description:
Up Close Inspections is a property inspection company in Northeast Ohio with over 15 years of experience. We work with US homebuyers, real estate agents, and loan officers.



This is a part-time, long-term independent contractor role, about 20 hours per week. Assigned shifts are scheduled within Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM Eastern Time. We will give you your exact schedule at least one week ahead. You are expected to be available only during your assigned shifts — no availability is required outside those shifts, and there is no unpaid standby once you are hired. For reference, that 9:00 AM–6:00 PM ET window is 10:00 PM–7:00 AM Philippine time during US standard time, and 9:00 PM–6:00 AM during US daylight saving time; your assigned shifts are within that window and are not necessarily the full window.



Pay is $5.00 per hour during a paid two-week training period, then $8.00 per hour once you complete training and join the team. All training hours are paid. After you are hired, you will log every paid hour in Clockify, and pay is sent bi-weekly through Wise.



Your main job: follow up with our past clients and call US real estate agents to build referral relationships, while keeping every contact correctly tagged and moving through our GoHighLevel pipelines so nothing is missed. We also use Spectora for inspection scheduling.



**What you’ll do**

- Make outbound calls to US real estate agents and loan officers using our scripts

- Follow up with past and current clients by phone, text, and

- Move contacts and opportunities through GoHighLevel pipelines and log every call with clear notes

- Tag every contact correctly and keep the CRM clean

- Book inspections and offer add-on services (radon, sewer scope, mold, termite, water testing)

- Run agent outreach campaigns, follow up on tasks, and send review requests

- Follow our SOPs and call scripts

- Track paid time in Clockify



**Must have**

- Real phone experience. This is mandatory. We need 1+ year of outbound or inbound calling with US customers (BPO, sales, appointment setting, or similar). Applications without phone experience will not be considered.

- Clear, easy-to-understand, friendly phone English. Careful listening and accurate intake are essential. A native accent is not required.

- 1+ year of hands-on GoHighLevel experience: pipelines, opportunities, tags, smart lists, Conversations, calendars, workflows

- Reliable internet that meets these minimums: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, and ping under 80 ms. You must send a speedtest.net screenshot taken with any VPN turned off. Wired is preferred if you have it.

- A backup power plan and a backup internet plan (for example a second ISP, mobile data, or a backup connection)

- A quiet workspace and a noise-canceling headset

- Reply to messages within 30–60 minutes during your assigned shift



**Nice to have**

- US real estate, mortgage, or insurance experience

- Spectora or other scheduling software



**Why work with us**

- Long-term role with room to grow into full time

- Small, supportive team with clear SOPs, scripts, and training



**How to apply — please follow all instructions**



Applications that do not follow every step will not be reviewed. Applications without the required 1–2 minute English voice recording are automatically declined.



**Subject line:** NORTHEAST90 - [Your Name]



**Apply Points:** Apply using exactly 8 Apply Points. Applications that use a different number will not be reviewed.



Your application must include all of the following:



1. A new 1–2 minute voice recording in English (Vocaroo or a similar link is fine). In your own words, introduce yourself, describe your phone experience, and explain why you would be a good fit. Do not send an old clip. A native accent is not required; we need clear, professional phone English.



2. A short description of your phone experience, including company name, length of employment, about how many calls you handled per day, and whether you spoke with US customers or real estate professionals.



3. A short description of your GoHighLevel experience (pipelines, tags, workflows, and follow-up).



4. Whether you currently have any other jobs or commitments.



5. Confirmation that you can commit to at least 90 days, and that you will give two weeks’ notice if you leave.



6. Your backup plan if your power or internet goes out.



7. Which hours, in Eastern Time, you can work each day.



8. A new speedtest.net screenshot, taken with any VPN turned off (wired, if you can). We need to see download, upload, and ping.



**What happens next (unpaid screening, then paid training)**



Before any paid time, shortlisted applicants complete an unpaid screening:



1. The audio intro (required with your application)

2. A timed written
/text test

3. A mock phone call

4. A GoHighLevel sandbox test

5. An internet and backup-power check



Only applicants who pass all five steps may be offered the paid two-week training at $5.00 per hour, then $8.00 per hour. All paid training and work hours are tracked in Clockify. Passing screening is not a job offer.



We’re looking for someone with real phone experience, clear and friendly English, strong GoHighLevel skills, and a professional phone presence. If you read this far, put NORTHEAST90 in your subject line, use exactly 8 Apply Points, and send the recording and speed test with your application.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Location: Philippines

Employment type: Full-time, 6 month Contract to Hire as full time



Solvera is recruiting on behalf of a US-headquartered client with operations across the United States and ASEAN. Our client provides digital, web, and creative services that help businesses strengthen their brands, reach customers, and grow.



Our client is seeking an Executive Assistant to support its CEO and another senior leader, helping them focus their time on the decisions, relationships, and priorities that matter most.



The Opportunity

Entrepreneurial leaders often have more ideas and opportunities than hours in the day. Meetings compete with decisions, priorities shift, and important actions can lose momentum when nobody owns the follow-through.



This role brings clarity to that environment. You will help the CEO and a senior leader make deliberate choices about their time, keep track of commitments, and ensure the right people have what they need to move work forward.



You will manage complex calendars and communications, but you will also look ahead: spotting competing priorities, chasing blockers, preparing leaders for decisions, and improving the systems behind the work. We’re looking for someone who can think quickly, exercise sound judgement, and bring order without slowing the business down.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES (Not absolute, CEO will work with you to identify which areas you can own): 



1) Executive support and calendar management

- Manage the CEO’s and senior leader’s calendars, balancing strategic priorities, client commitments, internal meetings, and time for focused work.

- Assess meeting requests, clarify their purpose and urgency, and recommend what should be scheduled, delegated, rescheduled, or declined.

- Coordinate meetings across time zones, ensuring participants have the relevant information and materials in advance.

- Prepare concise daily and weekly schedules that highlight priorities, decisions, deadlines, and potential conflicts.

- Anticipate changes and reorganize schedules quickly when business needs shift.

- Coordinate travel, itineraries, appointments, and related logistics when required.



2) Priorities, actions, and follow-through

- Maintain a clear view of the executives’ priorities, commitments, and deadlines.

- Translate meetings and discussions into action items with owners and due dates.

- Follow up with stakeholders, identify blockers, and escalate issues that need executive attention.

- Help leaders distinguish urgent matters from work that can be delegated, deferred, or handled by others.

- Prepare brief status updates so executives can see what is progressing, what is at risk, and where a decision is needed.

- Keep track of ideas and new opportunities, helping leaders determine the next step and owner.



3) Executive communications

- Monitor and organize executive correspondence as authorized, flagging urgent matters and bringing relevant context to the leaders’ attention.

- Draft and, where authorized, send
s and responses on behalf of the CEO and senior leader.

- Communicate professionally with clients, partners, and internal teams, adapting to the executive’s voice and the situation.

- Follow up on outstanding requests and ensure correspondence is acknowledged and actioned.

- Handle sensitive information with discretion and sound judgement.

- Know when to respond independently and when to seek direction or escalate.



4) Systems, automation, and continuous improvement

- Review recurring administrative work and identify opportunities to simplify or automate it.

- Design and maintain practical systems for tracking priorities, meetings, actions, documents, and follow-ups.

- Use digital tools and automation to reduce manual work and improve visibility across executive commitments.

- Set up or improve templates, reminders, workflows, and dashboards that help the leaders and their teams stay organized.

- Explore appropriate AI and productivity tools, applying them thoughtfully while protecting confidential information.

- Document processes so they are easy to maintain and improve.



5) Meeting preparation and executive coordination

- Prepare agendas, briefing notes, background information, and relevant documents before meetings.

- Capture key decisions and actions, and ensure follow-ups reach the right people.

- Coordinate with managers and project owners to obtain updates, reports, and materials.

- Help prepare presentations, correspondence, and executive summaries.

- Maintain organized files and ensure executives can find information quickly.

- Coordinate across teams to keep leadership priorities moving.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR: 

- At least five years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Senior Executive Assistant, Executive Business Partner, or in a similar role supporting senior leaders.

- Experience managing complex calendars, competing priorities, and communications for executives.

- Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to draft clear, professional correspondence on behalf of senior leaders.

- Strong organizational skills and a proven ability to follow through until work is completed.

- Experience using digital tools to improve workflows, manage information, or automate recurring tasks.

- Confidence working with senior stakeholders and following up on overdue commitments.

- Sound judgement, discretion, and the ability to handle sensitive information.

- Ability to anticipate needs, identify problems early, and propose practical solutions.

- Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where priorities can change.

- Proficiency in common productivity tools, including calendars, spreadsheets, presentations, and shared document systems.



What will distinguish candidates:

- Experience supporting an entrepreneurial CEO, founder, or senior leader in a growing business.

- Demonstrated examples of automations or systems they have introduced that saved time or improved follow-through.

- Experience supporting more than one executive and managing competing requests.

- Familiarity with project management tools, workflow automation platforms, and AI productivity tools.

- Experience coordinating across international teams and time zones.

- Ability to turn complex information into concise briefings and action plans.



Location, work eligibility, and availability: 

- We welcome applications from Filipino and expatriate candidates who are legally authorized to work in the Philippines. 

- Available for regular working-hour overlap with US Pacific Time to support the executives and coordinate with international teams. The agreed schedule will accommodate Pacific daylight saving changes.

- Willing to attend in-person meetings or travel as required.

title: YouTube Video Editor – Business Documentaries & Explainer Videos

I'm looking for someone who can turn a written script and voiceover into a highly engaging, professional-looking YouTube video, using a combination of stock footage, relevant images, animations, motion graphics, maps, charts, text overlays and sound design.



The editing style should be engaging and cinematic, with strong storytelling, smooth transitions and visual elements that keep viewers interested throughout the video. The editor should be able to bring the script to life through relevant footage, visuals, animated statistics, company imagery and engaging editing techniques.



Main responsibilities:



Edit long-form YouTube videos, typically around 15 minutes.



Turn provided scripts and voiceovers into engaging visual stories.



Source relevant stock footage, images and other visual assets.



Incorporate motion graphics, animated charts, maps and text overlays where appropriate.

title: Sales Executive – Digital, Web & Creative Solutions
description:
Solvera is recruiting on behalf of a US-headquartered client with operations across the United States and ASEAN. Our client provides digital, web, and creative services that help businesses strengthen their brands, reach customers, and grow.



We are looking for an experienced Sales Executive to develop new business, build client relationships, and turn customer requirements into well-scoped commercial opportunities.



The Opportunity

A business may know it needs a stronger online presence, a better website, or a more effective way to reach customers. Your job is to understand what it is trying to achieve, identify the right combination of services, and turn that conversation into a strong commercial opportunity.



You will work with creative, marketing, and web development specialists to shape proposals for clients across different industries. You will own your pipeline and lead opportunities from the first conversation through negotiation and close.

This role offers direct involvement in growing the client’s business across international markets. It calls for someone who can build trust with decision-makers, spot opportunities beyond the initial brief, and deliver results against sales targets.



Key responsibilities

1) New business development

- Identify and engage prospective clients through research, referrals, networking, outreach, and other approved channels.

- Build a qualified pipeline across businesses and industries suited to the client’s services.

- Understand prospects’ business objectives, challenges, budget, decision-making process, and timeline.

- Arrange and lead discovery calls, meetings, presentations, and pitches.

- Follow up consistently and move opportunities through the sales process.

- Deliver agreed sales activity, pipeline, and revenue targets.



2) Solution selling and proposals

- Develop a strong understanding of the client’s services, including:

     - Website design and development.

     - E-commerce development.

     - Digital marketing and social media.

     - Search engine optimization and paid digital advertising.

     - Graphic design, branding, and corporate identity.

     - Photography, video production, and content.

     - Print and other marketing materials.

- Identify opportunities to offer individual services or combine them into a broader proposal.

- Work with creative, marketing, and technical specialists to confirm scope, deliverables, timelines, and pricing.

- Prepare presentations, quotations, proposals, and responses to client enquiries.

- Explain recommendations clearly and address client questions or objections.

- Negotiate commercial terms within approved limits and secure the necessary internal approvals.

- Maintain accurate records of proposals, agreements, and client commitments.



3) Client relationships and account growth

- Build professional relationships with clients and understand their changing needs.

- Identify opportunities for additional services, project extensions, and ongoing engagements.

- Coordinate a clear handover to the relevant delivery teams after a sale.

- Stay engaged with clients and help resolve commercial or communication concerns.

- Gather client feedback and share relevant insights with internal teams.

- Support retention and repeat business through timely follow-up and reliable service.



4) Sales planning and reporting

- Maintain accurate prospect, pipeline, and activity records in the designated CRM or sales tracker.

- Provide regular updates on opportunities, proposals, forecasts, wins, and losses.

- Track progress against individual targets and identify actions needed to close gaps.

- Share market insights, competitor activity, and customer feedback with leadership.

- Contribute ideas to improve prospecting, proposals, and client acquisition.



What we are looking for

- At least five years of B2B sales, business development, or account management experience.

- Experience selling digital marketing, website development, creative, advertising, branding, or related professional services.

- A demonstrable record of developing opportunities and achieving sales targets.

- Confidence prospecting, conducting discovery meetings, presenting proposals, and negotiating with clients.

- Ability to understand business requirements and coordinate solutions with marketing, creative, or technical specialists.

- Very strong written and spoken English.

- Good commercial judgement and attention to scope, pricing, and client commitments.

- Proficiency in CRM systems, spreadsheets, presentations, and virtual meeting tools.

- Ability to manage multiple opportunities and follow through on commitments.



Experience that will distinguish candidates

- Selling to clients in the United States or other international markets.

- Working within a digital agency, creative agency, advertising agency, web development company, or professional services business.

- Selling both one-off projects and ongoing service agreements.

- Developing new accounts independently through outbound prospecting.

- Preparing proposals involving several services or delivery teams.

- Building long-term client relationships that generated repeat business.



Location, work eligibility, and availability

- Based in the Philippines.

- We welcome applications from Filipino and expatriate candidates who are legally authorized to work in the Philippines.

- Available for regular working-hour overlap with US Pacific Time to collaborate with leadership and engage international clients. The agreed schedule will accommodate Pacific daylight saving changes.

- Willing to attend client meetings and company events where required.

title: AI Operations & Social Media Manager (Virtual Assistant)
description:
Position: AI Operations & Social Media Manager

Company: EasyTaxesOnline

Location: Remote (Anywhere — U.S. time zone overlap required)

Hours: 35-40 hours/week

Type: Contract / Long-term



ABOUT EASYTAXESONLINE

EasyTaxesOnline is a modern tax preparation and financial services company with 20+ years of expertise. We help individuals and businesses with expert tax preparation, credit optimization, business formation, funding readiness, and financial education. We're based in Las Vegas and serve clients nationwide.

We recently rebranded and are launching an aggressive social media and marketing campaign. We need someone to manage our AI-powered content creation and social media operations so our founder can focus on tax preparation and business strategy.



THE ROLE

You will be the AI Operations Manager and Social Media Manager for EasyTaxesOnline. This is NOT a traditional social media role — you'll be using AI tools extensively to create, manage, and publish content at scale.

You will manage:



AI content generation tools (image, video, copy)

Social media scheduling and publishing

Community engagement (replies, DMs, comments)

Brand quality control

Basic analytics and reporting



You will NOT be responsible for:



Creating all content from scratch manually

Developing overall business strategy

Managing paid advertising (initially)

Customer service or sales





WHAT YOU'LL DO DAILY

Content Creation (using AI tools):



Generate social media graphics, carousels, and images using AI design tools

Create short-form video content using AI video tools

Create and manage AI avatar/clone videos for promotional content

Write captions and copy using AI writing assistants

Edit and refine AI outputs to match brand guidelines

Ensure all content meets our brand standards before publishing



Social Media Management:



Schedule and publish 25-45 posts/day across 5 platforms

Manage Instagram,
, LinkedIn, X/Twitter, and TikTok

Post Stories (10-12/day Instagram, 6-8/day
)

Monitor comments and DMs — respond or escalate as needed

Engage with relevant accounts to grow our presence



Quality Control:



Review all AI-generated content against brand guidelines

Ensure correct colors, fonts, messaging, and tone

Flag anything that needs founder approval

Maintain content calendar and asset organization



Reporting:



Track basic metrics (followers, engagement, reach)

Weekly summary of performance

Note what's working and what's not





WEEKLY VOLUME

This is a high-volume role. Here's what you'll manage:



X/Twitter: 7-10 posts per day (49-70 per week)

Instagram: 2 feed posts + 2-3 Reels + 10-12 Stories per day (98-119 pieces per week)

: 2 feed posts + 6-8 Stories per day (56-70 pieces per week)

LinkedIn: 2 posts per day (14 per week)

TikTok: 5-6 posts per day (35-42 per week)



Total:
+ pieces of content per week



This is achievable with AI tools — but you must be comfortable working with AI and moving quickly.



REQUIREMENTS

Must Have:



2+ years experience managing social media accounts (business, not personal)

Hands-on experience with AI tools for content creation

Strong written English (captions, replies, engagement)

Highly organized and detail-oriented

Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision

Reliable internet and computer setup

Available during U.S. business hours (at least 4-5 hour overlap with Pacific Time)



Experience We're Looking For:



Managing multiple social media platforms simultaneously

Using AI to generate images, graphics, or designs

Using AI to generate or edit written content

Creating AI avatars/clones for video content

Scheduling tools and content calendars

Working with brand guidelines and style guides





APPLICATION QUESTIONS (Required)

Please answer ALL of the following in your application. Applications without answers will not be considered.



1. AI Tools Experience

List ALL the AI tools you have used for work (not just heard of). For each tool, briefly describe what you used it for and how often.

Categories to address:

 AI image/graphic generation tools

 AI video generation tools

 AI avatar/clone creation tools

 AI copywriting/text tools

 AI design tools

 Any other AI tools



Example format:

"[Tool Name] — Used for [purpose], [frequency of use], [how long you've used it]"





2. AI Avatar/Clone Experience

a) Have you created AI avatars or AI clones for video content? If yes, describe:

 What tools did you use?

 What was the process from start to finish?

 How did you train or set up the avatar/clone?

 What types of videos did you create with it?



b) What are the biggest challenges when creating AI avatar videos that look professional and natural?

c) If you haven't created AI clones before, describe any experience you have with AI video tools and your willingness to learn avatar creation.





3. Social Media Management Experience

 a) What social media accounts have you managed? List the platforms, account type (business/personal), and approximate 

 follower count.

 b) What was the highest posting volume you've managed? (posts per day/week)

 c) What scheduling tools have you used? List them and describe your experience level with each.





4. Working Style

 a) Describe your process for managing a high volume of content. How do you stay organized?

 b) How do you handle a situation where AI generates content that doesn't match brand guidelines?

 c) What hours are you available to work? What time zone are you in?





5. Quick Test

Here's a simple brand guideline: "Our brand uses navy blue (#142952) as the primary color, green (#39AC6B) for buttons, and gold (#F0B810) for accents. Our tone is professional and confident — never cheap or gimmicky."

Imagine an AI tool generated a social media post with a bright red background, Comic Sans font, and the caption "CRAZY DEALS!!! Act NOW before it's too late!!!"

 a) What's wrong with this output?

 b) How would you fix it or what would you prompt the AI to regenerate?





6. Availability & Rate

 a) When can you start?

 b) What is your hourly rate in USD?

 c) Are you available for 35-40 hours/week?



WHAT WE PROVIDE



Comprehensive brand guidelines (colors, fonts, voice, imagery rules)

Detailed content calendar and posting schedule

Access to AI tools (we'll provide subscriptions)

Training on our specific brand requirements

Clear communication and feedback

Long-term opportunity as we grow





COMPENSATION



Hourly rate: Competitive, based on experience

Payment: Weekly or bi-weekly via PayPal, Wise, or similar

Long-term: This is an ongoing role, not a one-time project





HOW TO APPLY



Send your application to 
] with subject line: "AI Social Media Manager — [Your Name]"

Include:



Answers to ALL application questions above

Your resume or portfolio link

Links to social media accounts you've managed (if public) or screenshots

Examples of AI-generated content you've created (if available)





Applications that don't answer the questions will be automatically rejected.





HIRING PROCESS



Application review (1-2 days)

Short video interview (15-20 min)

Paid test project (2-3 hours of work)

Final decision



We're looking to hire within 1-2 weeks.



RED FLAGS (What Will Disqualify You)



Listing AI tools you haven't actually used

Vague answers like "I'm familiar with many AI tools"

No specific examples of social media accounts managed

Poor English writing in your application

Not answering all the application questions





GREEN FLAGS (What We Love to See)



Specific examples with metrics

Screenshots or portfolio of work

Experience creating AI avatars/clones with examples

Honest about what you know vs. what you're learning

Clear, organized communication

Proactive problem-solving mindset





We're excited to find the right person to join our team. If you're comfortable with AI tools and thrive in fast-paced, high-volume environments, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Director of International Brands & Retail Markets
description:
Location: Philippines, with local and international travel as needed

Employment type: Full-time, Contract to Hire



Solvera is recruiting on behalf of a US-headquartered client with operations across the United States and ASEAN. With an established presence in the Philippines, our client is expanding its portfolio of international brands, products, and supply solutions across consumer, institutional, and commercial markets.



We are seeking a commercially accomplished Director of International Brands & Retail Markets to lead brand acquisition, partnerships, market entry, and retail expansion.



This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can identify brands with strong market potential, negotiate sound commercial agreements, and build the channels and operating discipline needed to deliver profitable growth.



The Opportunity

You will lead the development and performance of the international brands and retail portfolio, from identifying potential partners and securing commercial rights through launch, distribution, and ongoing growth.



Working closely with executive leadership, you will develop the portfolio strategy, build retail and distribution relationships, and make investment recommendations supported by clear commercial analysis.



Key responsibilities

1) Portfolio strategy and international brand partnerships

Develop the portfolio strategy, identifying priority categories, brands, customer segments, and markets.

Identify and engage international brand owners seeking representation or expansion in the Philippines and selected ASEAN markets.

Evaluate distribution, licensing, franchise, and other commercial partnership opportunities.

Prepare business cases covering market demand, competition, pricing, investment requirements, risks, and expected returns.

Lead negotiations on territory, exclusivity, distribution and channel rights, purchase commitments, marketing support, payment terms, and performance obligations.

Assess partner credibility, supply reliability, product suitability, and contractual risks with Finance, Legal, and Operations.

Build strong relationships with international principals and monitor delivery against agreed commitments.

Recommend when to invest, expand, renegotiate, reposition, or exit a brand.



2) Market entry and brand development

Develop market-entry plans covering positioning, assortment, pricing, route to market, launch investment, and financial targets.

Translate international brand standards into locally relevant commercial execution.

Coordinate product readiness, regulatory requirements, supply arrangements, marketing, and channel activation.

Establish launch milestones, budgets, ownership, and performance measures.

Use customer insights, sales data, and competitor analysis to refine product selection and positioning.

Evaluate expansion into selected ASEAN markets, accounting for differences in demand, regulation, distribution, and channel economics.

Manage brand performance beyond launch, with attention to sustained sales, repeat demand, and viable margins.



3) Retail, distribution, and channel growth

Develop the appropriate mix of retail, wholesale, distribution, e-commerce, marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and institutional channels.

Build and maintain relationships with retail groups, distributors, commercial partners, and strategic accounts.

Negotiate listings, trading terms, promotions, and channel agreements that support profitable growth.

Set channel-specific pricing, assortment, service standards, and performance expectations.

Evaluate physical retail opportunities against location economics, investment requirements, payback, and operating capacity.

Maintain pricing discipline and manage channel conflict.

Improve sales productivity, sell-through, customer retention, and repeat purchasing.

Coordinate institutional or government opportunities with the relevant commercial and bidding teams.



4) Financial and commercial management

Own the portfolio’s P&L, annual business plan, budgets, and forecasts.

Set and deliver targets for revenue, gross margin, contribution, operating profit, and working capital.

Assess landed costs, foreign-exchange exposure, trade spending, promotional returns, and channel profitability.

Lead demand and inventory planning with Supply Chain, Sales, and Finance.

Monitor stock availability, inventory ageing, stock cover, returns, markdowns, and obsolescence.

Recommend allocation of capital and resources based on expected returns and execution capacity.

Review results against approved business cases and take corrective action where required.

Present clear performance reports, risks, and recommendations to executive leadership.



5) Leadership and execution

Build and lead the commercial team as the portfolio grows.

Establish clear responsibilities, decision rights, targets, and performance expectations.

Align Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Operations around shared priorities.

Establish processes for opportunity assessment, partner selection, launches, forecasting, and business reviews.

Set approval controls for pricing, discounts, trading terms, and investment commitments.

Develop team capability in negotiation, account management, commercial analysis, and execution.

Maintain accurate reporting and escalate material risks promptly.

Uphold contractual commitments, brand standards, and ethical business practices.



What we are looking for

At least 12 years of relevant commercial experience, including at least five years in senior leadership within branded products, retail, distribution, or a closely related business.

Demonstrated ownership of a substantial business or portfolio P&L, with measurable growth and profitability outcomes.

A proven record of securing international brand partnerships or negotiating significant distribution, licensing, or franchise agreements.

Direct responsibility for launching brands or entering new markets, including accountability for performance after launch.

Strong understanding of the Philippine retail and distribution landscape, supported by relevant commercial relationships.

Experience managing multiple brands, product categories, or channels with different commercial requirements.

Strong financial judgement across investment appraisal, pricing, margin management, inventory, and working capital.

Experience leading teams, managing budgets, and coordinating cross-functional execution.

Ability to negotiate directly with international principals and present recommendations to executive leadership.

Excellent written and spoken English.

A bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline. Relevant postgraduate qualifications are advantageous.



Experience that will distinguish candidates

Commercial responsibility across more than one ASEAN market.

Building a brand portfolio, distribution business, or business unit from an early stage.

Negotiating directly with international brand owners and regional headquarters.

Managing both physical retail and digital channels.

Developing institutional or B2B sales alongside consumer channels.

Turning around underperforming brands, channels, or inventory positions.

Working in an entrepreneurial environment where senior leaders remain directly involved in execution.



Leadership profile: We are looking for someone who makes sound investment decisions, builds strong partnerships, and takes ownership of commercial results. You should be comfortable developing a portfolio strategy and personally leading negotiations, partner meetings, and launches. You will need the judgement to challenge assumptions, the confidence to communicate risks, and the discipline to turn plans into profitable results.



Location, work eligibility, and availability

- Based in the Philippines.

title: Full-Time Dashboard Developer - Build Our Multi-Store P&L Command Center
description:

The problem we want you to solve



We run a multi-brand e-commerce group with 5 Shopify stores across the UK, US & EU , spending daily on Meta, Google and Pinterest Ads.



Right now our numbers live in different places: Shopify admin, three ad platforms, supplier COGS sheets, refund reports, spreadsheets. Every decision starts with tab-switching and manual checking.



We want one screen. A command center where we open a browser tab and instantly see, per store and blended: revenue, ad spend, COGS, refunds, ROAS, blended ROAS, profit and profit margin for today, the last 7 days, the last 30 days, or any custom date range.

Data connections



All 5 Shopify stores connected via API, with a clean architecture so we can add store #6, #7, #8 later without a rebuild

Meta Ads, Google Ads and Pinterest Ads connected for live ad spend per store

COGS pulled in per store either from Shopify or from our supplier system / cost sheets



Metrics

Revenue, ad spend, COGS, refunds, contribution margin

ROAS per platform and blended ROAS

Net profit and profit % per store and across the group

Order count, AOV, refund rate



Views



A multi-store view: everything visible in one consolidated set of charts

A per-store view: drill into any single brand

Clear, readable graphs for yesterday / 7 days / 30 days, plus a custom date picker

Period-over-period comparison so we can see whether we are growing or bleeding



Automation



Daily Slack update with yesterday's key numbers per store

Weekly Slack update with growth vs. the previous week

Must-have requirements

A demonstrable track record building a P&L / profit dashboard. Screenshots, a live demo, a Loom walkthrough or a repo — we want proof, not promises.

Comfortable working with APIs and API keys (Shopify Admin API, Meta Marketing API, Google Ads API, Pinterest API)

Hands-on with Supabase and/or Vercel for building and deploying

You work with Claude Code, Claude or Codex as part of your daily workflow — we build fast here

Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills — a lot of our cost and supplier data still starts life in a spreadsheet

Good written English and reliable daily communication

Experience with e-commerce / dropshipping data specifically

Growth path

A supply chain dashboard on top of the same system

A product listing system

Your track record — links, screenshots, a demo or a Loom of a P&L or analytics dashboard you actually built. Show us the real thing.
