title: Client Documents Coordinator (US Bankruptcy Law Firm) - Pre-Filing Document Collection
description:
READ THIS FIRST

To apply, start your message with the word DOCUMENTS and answer the four questions at the end. Applications that skip this get deleted unread. This job is about following instructions exactly, so the application is the first test.



WHO WE ARE

Van Horn Law Group, P.A. is a bankruptcy law firm in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. We file Chapter 7 and Chapter 13 consumer and business cases in four federal court districts. About 100 people work here, including 15 attorneys. We have been doing this for over a decade and we file cases every single week.



THE JOB IN ONE SENTENCE

Before we can file a client's case we need a complete, correct, current set of their financial documents, and you are the person who gets every one of them in so the case can be prepared and filed without delay.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Send new clients their document request and walk them through exactly what we need: pay stubs, bank statements, tax returns, IDs, bills and property documents.

- Follow up by
, text and phone until every document arrives, politely and persistently.

- Check each document when it arrives: right name, right dates, all pages, readable, covers the required period. Send it back the same day if it doesn't.

- Name and file every document in our case management system following our naming guide.

- Keep each case checklist current so anyone can see what is still missing in ten seconds.

- Hand a complete file to the prep team quickly and flag any case at risk early. Our goal is to file every case within two weeks of the client signing up.

- Escalate to the docs team lead when a client is stuck or a case looks complicated.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Someone who cannot stand a missing page. If a client sends a blurry photo, you catch it before the prep team does. If a client goes quiet, you find another way to reach them. You can be the calm, organized person asking a stressed client for the same bank statement a third time and have them thank you for it.



REQUIRED

- At least 1 year collecting and checking documents from people against a deadline. Law firm intake, mortgage processing, title, collections, insurance claims or medical billing all count. Bankruptcy experience is a big plus but not required.

- Excellent spoken and written English. You will be on the phone and
 with US clients every day.

- A real system for tracking open items. Tell us what it is.

- Available during US Eastern business hours.

- A reliable computer, backup power, a quiet place for calls, and internet of at least 25 Mbps. We will ask for a speed test screenshot.

- Able to sign a confidentiality agreement and work inside our secure systems. Our clients' financial information never leaves them.



IMPORTANT ABOUT THIS ROLE

You will never give clients legal advice. You collect documents, explain our process, and route every legal question to an attorney. We train you on exactly where that line sits.



NICE TO HAVE

Experience with Glade, Clio, Best Case or another case management system. Familiarity with bank statements, pay stubs and tax returns. Spanish is a plus.



WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive monthly salary in USD, paid on time. Paid time off plus Philippine holidays. HMO after the probationary period. Full paid training on our systems and US bankruptcy procedure. Real advancement. A long-term seat.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word DOCUMENTS. Then answer these four questions in your own words. Please do not use AI to write your answers.

1. Describe a job where you collected documents or information from people to complete a file by a deadline. How many files did you handle at once, and exactly how did you track them?

2. A client sends a blurry pay stub photo and a bank statement missing two pages. Walk us through exactly what you do, step by step.

3. What tools have you used to track document status, and what did you like or dislike about them?

4. What hours can you work in Philippine time, and are you comfortable on the phone with US clients?

Attach your resume and tell us your expected monthly salary in USD.

title: Blender 3D Character Artist & Animator
description:
OPPORTUNITY — 3D ARTIST, ANIMATOR & INTERACTIVE 3D DEVELOPER



Project: PNTZE — Interactive Education Platform

Location: Remote

Experience Level: Junior to Advanced

Engagement: Flexible — Depending on Skills and Experience



⸻



ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for a creative and technically capable individual with experience or an interest in 3D characters, animation, Blender, game development or interactive 3D applications.



We are developing an innovative education platform that uses animated 3D characters to create more engaging, personalised learning experiences.



Our character production process will be supported by existing technologies such as Avaturn, which can generate realistic 3D characters with pre-existing body rigs, facial animation capabilities, textures and appearance customisation.



This means you will not be expected to create complex human characters or character production systems entirely from scratch.



Instead, we are looking for someone who can work with existing characters, adapt them, improve them, animate them and help prepare them for use within our application.



We are open to candidates from different technical backgrounds, including those who have not previously specialised in human character development.



HOW OUR CHARACTER DEVELOPMENT PROCESS WORKS



Our intended workflow is:



Avaturn Character Generation

↓

Character Export & Refinement

↓

Animation & Facial Expressions

↓

Character Testing & Optimisation

↓

Interactive Application Integration



Much of the foundational character creation, texturing and rigging can be supported by existing technology.



Your role would involve helping us build upon these capabilities rather than independently developing every element of the character production process.



OUR MAIN AREAS OF INTEREST



You do not need experience in every area listed below. We are interested in candidates with practical abilities in one or more of these disciplines.



1. 3D MODELLING & CHARACTER CUSTOMISATION



Experience working with existing 3D models, particularly using Blender or similar software.



Relevant skills could include:



* Editing and modifying existing 3D models.

* Adjusting character appearances and proportions.

* Working with clothing, hairstyles and accessories.

* Applying or modifying materials and textures.

* Improving the visual quality of existing assets.

* Working with downloaded, premade or AI-generated 3D models.

* Preparing 3D assets for games or interactive applications.



You do not need advanced human modelling, sculpting or anatomical reconstruction experience.



Our character generation tools will provide the initial character models for you to work with.



2. CHARACTER ANIMATION & MOVEMENT



We are interested in candidates who enjoy working with animation and bringing 3D models to life.



Relevant experience could include:



* Basic or intermediate 3D animation.

* Working with animation timelines and keyframes.

* Applying existing animations to characters.

* Using Mixamo or other animation libraries.

* Editing and combining existing animations.

* Creating simple gestures and body movements.

* Working with facial expressions and character reactions.

* Improving animation transitions.



Examples of movements we are looking to develop include characters pointing, explaining, nodding, smiling, listening, demonstrating and providing encouragement.



You do not need to be an advanced professional animator. Experience working with existing animations and the ability to learn new techniques would be valuable.



3. WORKING WITH EXISTING CHARACTER RIGS



Our character generation technology can provide characters with existing skeletal rigs and facial animation controls.



We are interested in candidates who can work with, understand or learn how to adapt these systems.



Relevant experience could include:



* Working with Blender armatures and bones.

* Using premade rigged characters.

* Applying animations to existing character rigs.

* Basic weight painting and deformation adjustments.

* Working with facial shape keys or blendshapes.

* Animation retargeting.

* Identifying and correcting character movement issues.



You are not required to have experience building advanced skeletal or facial rigging systems from scratch.



4. GAME DEVELOPMENT & INTERACTIVE 3D



Candidates with experience in game development or interactive 3D environments are particularly encouraged to apply.



Relevant experience could include:



* Unity.

* Unreal Engine.

* Godot.

* Three.js.

* React Three Fiber.

* WebGL.

* Interactive character controls.

* Animation state machines.

* Character movement systems.

* Importing and exporting 3D assets.

* Integrating animated characters into games or applications.



Experience creating interactive experiences using existing characters, assets or animation libraries could transfer directly into our project.



You do not necessarily need to be a traditional 3D artist if you have relevant interactive 3D development experience.



5. SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT & AUTOMATION



We also welcome software developers who are interested in working with 3D character technology.



Relevant experience could include:



* JavaScript or TypeScript.

* React or Next.js.

* Python or Node.js.

* API and SDK integrations.

* Blender Python scripting.

* AI-assisted development.

* Automated asset processing.

* Automated character generation.

* Animation control systems.

* 3D asset validation and optimisation.

* Integrating existing technologies into applications.



We are particularly interested in individuals who can identify ways to simplify, automate and improve existing workflows.



You do not need extensive character modelling experience if your software development capabilities could contribute to working with, controlling or integrating animated 3D characters.



6. UI/UX DESIGN & FIGMA — ADDITIONAL ADVANTAGE



Candidates with additional UI/UX design or application development experience would also be of interest.



This could include:



* Figma and interactive prototyping.

* Mobile or web application design.

* Front-end development.

* Responsive interfaces.

* Integrating interactive characters into application screens.

* Designing character customisation interfaces.

* Improving interactive user experiences.



These skills are advantageous but are not essential for the role.



SOFTWARE & TOOLS



Experience with any of the following would be beneficial:



* Blender

* Avaturn

* Mixamo

* Unity

* Unreal Engine

* Godot

* Autodesk Maya

* Character Creator

* iClone

* Three.js

* React Three Fiber

* Meshy AI

* Tripo

* Figma



You are not expected to know all of these tools.



Previous experience with Avaturn is not required. We are equally interested in candidates who are confident learning unfamiliar software and applying their existing technical skills.



ABOUT PNTZE



PNTZE is an interactive, creator-led education platform designed to make learning more engaging, supportive and personalised.



The platform will use animated 3D characters to guide users through learning activities, demonstrate techniques, respond to progress and provide encouragement.



For example, a makeup educator could be represented by an animated character that demonstrates techniques, explains different processes and supports students throughout their learning experience.



We intend to progressively develop these characters from simple animated personalities into more intelligent and interactive digital characters.



Our objective is to achieve professional visual quality, natural character movements and engaging interactions without unnecessarily recreating technology that already exists.



YOUR POTENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES



Depending on your experience and strengths, your responsibilities could include:



* Generating and exporting characters using existing avatar technologies.

* Importing and working with characters in Blender.

* Customising character appearances.

* Applying existing animations.

* Creating additional gestures and facial expressions.

* Testing animations across different characters.

* Improving character movements and visual quality.

* Preparing characters for mobile and web applications.

* Optimising 3D assets for performance.

* Integrating characters into interactive environments.

* Developing reusable animation libraries.

* Helping automate repetitive character production tasks.

* Exploring new tools that could improve our development process.



You will not necessarily be responsible for all of these activities.



We already have a developer working on the application’s architecture, development and integration. We are looking for someone who can complement the existing team through their own particular strengths.



We are open to adapting the responsibilities of the role around the abilities and experience of the successful candidate.



WHO SHOULD APPLY?



We welcome applications from:



* Junior and intermediate 3D artists.

* Blender generalists.

* 3D animators.

* Game developers.

* Game artists.

* Technical artists.

* 3D visualisation specialists.

* Interactive 3D developers.

* Creative software developers.

* AI-assisted 3D asset creators.

* Front-end developers interested in interactive 3D.

* Individuals with relevant personal, freelance or educational projects.

* Multidisciplinary individuals with transferable technical skills.



Professional studio experience is not essential.



You do not need to have previously created realistic digital humans, developed advanced rigging systems or built an entire character production pipeline.



We are interested in practical ability, creativity, adaptability, problem-solving and a willingness to learn.



If you have experience working with 3D models, animations, game engines, software integrations or similar technologies, we would encourage you to apply.



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



To help us understand your experience, please provide:



1. Examples of previous work or personal projects relevant to this opportunity.

2. The software, tools or programming languages you are most comfortable using.

3. A brief explanation of your strongest technical skills.

4. Which areas of this opportunity you believe you could contribute to.

5. Any areas you would be interested in learning or developing further.

6. Your expected hourly rate and weekly availability.



You are not required to demonstrate expertise in every area of this job description.



We are looking for someone who can make effective use of existing technology, solve practical challenges and develop their capabilities alongside our team.



If you believe your skills could contribute to this project, even if your background does not match every requirement, we would be interested in hearing from you.

Administrative & Marketing Assistant (Virtual)

s sent to chapter’s
, using templates provided by the Board, follow up on outstanding action items; simplify or automate repetitive tasks.

Design and publish marketing newsletters and event announcements in Constant Contact.  Create and schedule social media posts.  Create and update brochures, flyers, and event slide decks. 5. Enjoys documenting processes and creating templates and tools that others can use.

6. Dedicated, quiet workspace with reliable internet and a working Windows laptop with Microsoft Office. Two US-based references, each with at least 2 years’ working relationship and within the last 5 years.

 your CV, and a one-paragraph summary of results you delivered in a past role (for example, sample newsletters you produced, event registrations managed, or URLs to website you kept current) to

title: BOOKKEEPER/ BUSINESS MANAGEMENT STAFF
description:
## POSITION OVERVIEW



We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Business Management / Bookkeeping Staff member to provide day-to-day accounting and administrative support for one of our key clients. This position will work closely with the client and our accounting team to manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, commission reporting, financial records, and other business management responsibilities.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, responsive, able to manage multiple priorities, and comfortable communicating directly with clients, vendors, and employees.



## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



### Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable



* Manage and maintain accounts payable and accounts receivable.

* Process vendor invoices, payments, and customer receipts.

* Monitor outstanding receivables and follow up on past-due balances.

* Maintain accurate vendor and customer records.

* Assist with cash flow monitoring and payment scheduling.



### Commission Reporting



* Prepare recurring commission reports and calculations.

* Review sales and transaction information for accuracy.

* Coordinate commission payments and resolve discrepancies.

* Maintain supporting documentation for commission calculations.



### Payroll



* Coordinate and process payroll information.

* Review payroll reports for accuracy.

* Maintain employee payroll records and assist with payroll-related questions.

* Coordinate with the payroll provider and accounting team as needed.



### Client Support



* Serve as a primary day-to-day contact for the client regarding accounting and business management matters.

* Respond to client questions and requests in a timely and professional manner.

* Coordinate with vendors, employees, and other third parties on behalf of the client.

* Identify issues and communicate them to the appropriate accounting or management team.



### Bookkeeping & Financial Administration



* Perform bank and credit card reconciliations.

* Maintain accurate and organized accounting records.

* Assist with monthly financial reporting and account analysis.

* Enter and review transactions in QuickBooks Online.

* Assist with budgeting, cash flow tracking, and other financial analysis as needed.



### General Business Management Support



* Handle miscellaneous accounting, business management, and administrative tasks related to the client's business.

* Assist with special projects and financial research.

* Maintain organized electronic records and supporting documentation.

* Coordinate with the tax and accounting teams regarding tax filings, information requests, and year-end matters.

* Take on additional responsibilities as needed to support the client's business operations.



## QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS



* Minimum 2 years of experience working with U.S.-based clients or accounts.

* 2+ years of bookkeeping, accounting, business management, or related experience.

* Strong understanding of accounts payable and accounts receivable.

* Experience with payroll and commission calculations preferred.

* QuickBooks Online experience preferred.

* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.

* Excellent attention to detail and organization.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.

* Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive financial and payroll information.

* Strong client service and communication skills.



## IDEAL CANDIDATE



The ideal candidate is someone who can become familiar with the client's business and serve as a reliable day-to-day financial resource. This person should be proactive, dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of responsibilities.



## WHAT TO EXPECT



As a member of our team, you can expect:



* A welcoming and inclusive environment where your opinions and ideas are valued.

* Opportunities for personal and professional growth through ongoing training and development.

* Competitive compensation and benefits to support you and your family.

* Flexibility to achieve a work-life balance that suits your needs.

* An atmosphere that encourages innovation, creativity, and collaboration.

* Regular team-building activities and social events to unwind and build lasting relationships with your colleagues.



## WORK SCHEDULE



**Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time (California time)**



## WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?



* Competitive salary, depending on experience

* 24 PTO credits

* Remote opportunity — work from the comfort of your home

* Long-term opportunity with career growth and advancement



## OUR BACKGROUND



We are a **U.S.-based accounting firm** committed to providing exceptional service and value to our clients. We believe our success starts with a strong, qualified team and a supportive company culture.



We value teamwork, professional growth, and a positive attitude. Our core belief is that **attitude is just as important, if not more important, than technical skills**, and we strive to create an environment where our team members feel valued, supported, and empowered to grow.

title: US Tax Specialist
description:
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:



Tax Preparation & Compliance

*Independently prepare and review US federal and state tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Manage approximately 100 annual returns across individual and business clients.

*Prepare complex multi entity returns, including partnership and S corporation reporting, shareholder and partner basis calculations, K-1s, and related schedules.

*Analyze financial statements, prior-year returns, accounting records, and supporting documentation for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare tax adjustments, reconciliations, and year-end journal entries.

*Maintain accurate workpapers and supporting documentation.

*Research federal and state tax regulations, identify technical issues, and recommend appropriate treatment.

*Prepare extensions, estimated tax calculations, and required compliance filings.

*Research and prepare responses to IRS and state tax notices and correspondence.

*Complete first-level technical reviews and submit work for final approval.

*Proactively manage filing deadlines and identify missing information or potential compliance issues.



Tax Planning & Strategy

*Prepare comprehensive federal and state income tax projections for business owners and their entities throughout the year.

*Identify and evaluate tax-saving opportunities involving entity structures, owner compensation, retirement plans, deductions, credits, distributions, and other planning strategies.

*Research advanced tax issues involving multiple business entities and overlapping individual and business tax considerations.

*Model alternative strategies and calculate their financial and tax implications.

*Prepare detailed calculations and clear strategy recommendations for founder review.

*Monitor legislative and regulatory changes affecting our clients.

*Collaborate with the bookkeeping and CFO teams to ensure accounting records support accurate and effective tax planning.

*Assist with implementing approved tax strategies and monitoring their results.



Payroll & Accounting Coordination

*Process monthly payroll through our payroll software.

*Review quarterly and annual federal and state payroll tax filings for accuracy and completeness.

*Prepare manual payroll tax filings for specialized client arrangements, including family management companies.

*Reconcile payroll records, tax liabilities, employee compensation, and bookkeeping accounts.

*Review payroll-related adjusting journal entries and year-end accounting records.

*Ensure accurate reporting of shareholder compensation, payroll deductions, benefits, and other tax-sensitive payroll transactions.

*Coordinate with the bookkeeping team to resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate financial records.



Tax Operations & Team Collaboration

*Independently manage assigned projects, priorities, and deadlines.

*Communicate proactively with our Client Success Manager and bookkeeping team regarding missing information, deadlines, and outstanding questions.

*Maintain accurate project status and documentation in our practice management systems.

*Follow established quality control procedures and identify opportunities to improve them.

*Develop and refine standard operating procedures, templates, and internal workflows.

*Identify opportunities to streamline tax preparation, research, projections, and compliance through technology and automation.

*Participate in team meetings, training, and professional development.



EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

*Minimum 5 years of , including substantial experience preparing individual and business returns. Candidates with 8–12 years of experience are especially encouraged to apply.

*Extensive experience preparing US federal individual and business tax returns, including Forms 1040, 1120, 1120-S, and 1065.

*Proficiency in using Tax software. Experience in Intuit ProConnect Tax Online is a huge advantage.

*Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex calculations, reconciliations, and financial analysis.

*Experience working with US accounting firms and/or US-based clients.

*Strong working knowledge of US federal tax law and relevant state tax requirements.

*Experience with pass-through entities, shareholder and partner basis, business structures, and individual tax considerations.

*Ability to prepare tax returns independently, evaluate technical accuracy, and identify matters requiring further research or review.

title: Amazon Operations & QA Assistant (AI-Native)
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented Amazon Operations & QA Assistant to help run inventory operations inside our software, Inventory Hero. The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, supply chain and inventory management, and will be comfortable working alongside AI every day. Your responsibilities will include:



Responsibilities:

- Finding and filing Amazon inventory reimbursements

- Creating FBA shipments for our clients

- Following up with suppliers and freight forwarders until shipments arrive

- Double-checking numbers in reports, forecasts and purchase orders

- Checking the work our AI agents do before it reaches a client

- Testing new features and writing clear bug reports

- Following QA issues through until they are fixed



About Inventory Hero:

Inventory Hero is supply chain software for Amazon and TikTok sellers. Our software forecasts demand, plans purchase orders and shipments, and finds money Amazon owes sellers. Much of the work is done by AI agents, and our team makes sure the agents get it right. We are a small, fully remote team built by people who have sold on Amazon for years.



We have established systems and SOPs, but we welcome new ideas for doing things better and faster. Experience with Amazon Seller Central is required. You will use Claude (an AI assistant) every day, so you should be comfortable with AI and curious about how to use it well. We will provide training on our software and processes.



Qualifications:

- Strong knowledge of Amazon Seller Central (FBA shipments, reports, reimbursement cases)

- Experience with supply chain and inventory management for Amazon brands

- TikTok Shop experience (preferred)

- Daily use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT, and a habit of checking their answers

- Strong attention to detail with numbers

- Clear written and spoken English



Your main KPIs will include:

- Reimbursements recovered for our clients

- Shipments created and delivered on time

- Errors caught before they reach a client

- Downloading reports that can't be automated. 

- Bugs reported clearly and followed through to a fix



This is a part-time position requiring 10-15 hours a week, with flexible hours. You will need to be available up to 2 hours a week during California business hours (9 am to 4 pm Pacific), scheduled ahead of time. Pay is $10 USD per hour. We use Slack and Loom for communication.



How to Apply:

- Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter explaining your Amazon and supply chain experience.

- In your cover letter, tell us about one time an AI tool gave you a wrong answer and how you caught it.

- Look at our website, 
ventoryhero.ai, and offer one suggestion on how to improve it.

- We will pick 5-10 people to do a paid quiz to test your abilities.



We look forward to hearing from you and potentially welcoming you to our team, where your work will directly help Amazon sellers keep products in stock and get back the money they are owed.

title: Content Writer & AI Content Editor – SEO Articles
description:
We need a skilled writer to create blog articles and service pages for our clients, and to edit AI-generated drafts so they read like they were written by a real person.



Read Before Applying

This is not a “run it through a humanizer tool” job. We need a real writer who can rewrite AI drafts by hand: adding personality, local details, real examples, and a natural flow. If your process relies on paraphrasing tools or spinners, this job is not for you.

What You Will Do

Writing original articles

    • Write blog posts, service pages, and location pages 

    • Research topics and write for local business customers 

    • Follow SEO briefs (target keyword, headings, internal links) 

Editing and humanizing AI drafts

    • Rewrite AI-generated articles so they sound natural and human 

    • Remove robotic phrases, filler, repetition, and generic intros/conclusions 

    • Add real-world examples, local references, and practical tips 

    • Vary sentence length and rhythm so the writing flows 

    • Match each client’s brand voice (friendly, professional, expert, etc.) 

    • Fact-check claims, numbers, and advice 

Quality

    • Clear headings, short paragraphs, and easy-to-scan formatting 

    • Correct grammar and spelling (US English) 

    • Write meta titles and meta descriptions 

    • Upload to WordPress or GoHighLevel when needed (a plus, not required) 

What We Are Looking For

    • At least 2 years of professional content writing experience (required) 

    • Native or near-native English writing skills 

    • Experience writing SEO content 

    • A strong ear for what sounds natural vs. what sounds like AI 

    • Ability to write simply for everyday readers, not academics 

    • Reliable with deadlines 

Nice to Have

    • Experience editing AI-generated content 

    • Experience writing for local service businesses 

    • Familiarity with tools like Grammarly 



How to Apply

    1. Start your application with the words “REAL WRITER” so we know you read the full post 

    2. Share 2–3 links or samples of articles you’ve written (SEO or local business content preferred) 

    3. In 3–4 sentences, explain how you would turn a robotic AI draft into a natural, engaging article 

    4. Tell us your rate per article or per 1,000 words, and your weekly capacity 





Applications without the keyword or real writing samples will be skipped.



Thank you

title: Short-Form Video Creator for Meta Andromeda Ads (Reels, Instagram, Facebook) | Music Promotion
description:
ABOUT US

We are a music promotion company that helps independent artists get their music heard. We run curated Spotify playlists and a set of Instagram accounts that connect artists with real listeners. Most new artists find us through our paid ads on Instagram and
, so the quality of our video ads directly affects how fast we grow.

We are looking for a creative, data-minded video creator who can turn a scroll into a click.



THE ROLE

You will create video content for several of our music playlists, each with its own genre and audience:

- Indie Rock

- Hip-Hop

- Neoclassical

- Soul & R&B

- Lo-Fi

- [and more]

Each playlist needs its own visual style and tone. A Lo-Fi ad should not feel like a Hip-Hop ad. You need to be able to switch styles and still keep the content strong.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Create short vertical videos (9:16) for Reels, Stories and Meta feed ads, aimed at people on Instagram and
 to follow our 
 playlists.

- Produce a high volume of genuinely different ad concepts: new hooks, angles, formats, visual styles and messages, not just small edits of the same video

- Write scroll-stopping hooks for the first 1 to 3 seconds, plus short on-screen text and captions

- Use AI tools (video generation, voiceover, editing, captioning, image generation) to produce content quickly without losing quality

- Review ad performance with us (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, cost per click, landing page views) and use the results to plan the next round of creatives

- Keep creatives within Meta's ad policies and music licensing rules, so ads don't get rejected or muted

- Organize and label all creatives so we can track which concepts win



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

- A portfolio of short-form videos or ads you made yourself. Paid social ads with results are a big plus.

- A solid understanding of how Meta Andromeda changed advertising: the creative now does most of the targeting, broad audiences are standard, and the algorithm rewards real creative diversity over many near-identical variations

- Hands-on experience with AI content tools (for example CapCut, Higgsfield, Runway, Kling, Veo, ElevenLabs, Midjourney, or similar). Tell us which ones you use.

- Strong editing skills: pacing, captions, transitions, sound design, text animation

- Good written English for hooks and on-screen copy aimed at a Western audience of musicians

- Ability to work independently, meet deadlines and deliver in batches

- Reliable internet and a computer that can handle video editing



NICE TO HAVE

- Knowledge of the music industry, Spotify, playlists or independent artist culture

- Experience with Meta Ads Manager and reading ad performance data

- Motion graphics or basic animation skills

- Experience with UGC-style or faceless content formats



WHAT WE OFFER

- Creative freedom to test new ideas, with clear feedback based on real ad data

- Performance-based raises as your creatives prove themselves



HOW WE START: PAID TRIAL

We start with a paid trial on 2 of our playlists: Lo-Fi and Indie Rock. This lets you see how we work and lets us see your work.

- Duration: [e.g. 2 weeks]

- Deliverables: [e.g. 6 to 8 distinct ad creatives per playlist]

- Trial pay: [e.g. PHP X fixed for the full trial]



Lo-Fi calls for a calm, aesthetic, atmospheric style. Indie Rock calls for energy, attitude and raw visuals. We want to see that you can do both well.



We judge the trial on creative quality and on real ad performance. If it's a good match, you'll take over video content for our other playlists (Hip-Hop, Neoclassical, Soul & R&B and more) and move to a long-term role.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include:

1. Links to 3 to 5 short-form videos you created (ads preferred)

2. The AI tools you use and what you use each one for

3. In 3 to 5 sentences: how has Meta Andromeda changed the way you would build ad creatives for a new campaign?

4. Your expected monthly rate and available hours

5. A rough idea for one ad that would make an independent Lo-Fi or Indie Rock artist want to submit their song to a playlist



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a short paid test task. The best candidate then moves on to the paid trial with our Lo-Fi and Indie Rock playlists.

title: English Conversation Coach (1:1 Drills) – Korean Adult Learners
description:
We're launching an online English program for Korean adult learners around the world (beginner to lower-intermediate) and hiring friendly, supportive conversation coaches for 1:1 speaking sessions.



THE SESSIONS

- 25-minute 1:1 video calls

- Drill-based: very little explaining, lots of speaking practice

- Natural pace and tone. We want students to hear real, conversational English, not slow "teacher talk." You speak the way you would with a friend, and students learn to keep up.

- We will give you the exact content for every session (drills, questions, what to correct and how). You follow it and make it fun. No lesson planning needed. The idea is - this will be incredibly easy and smooth for you! 

- We launch with 25 students, 1 session per student per week, and we're growing after that



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Clear, natural, north american - sounding English (this matters most)

- Warm, patient, and engaging. You help shy beginners feel comfortable speaking.

- Reliable: on time, camera on, quiet space, stable internet, headset

- Basic Korean is a plus (not at all required)

- No teaching certificate needed. Call-center, tutoring, or ESL experience is helpful but not required.



SCHEDULE

- Part-time, up to about 6-12 hours per week. Hours depend on how many students enroll, and we will be honest with you about the numbers as we go. There is no guaranteed minimum at launch, and hours should grow as the program grows. We expect the program to grow quickly and we will add more hours if you are a good fit and you'd like more hours!

- Flexible hours across the day. Our students are in Korea, China, and the US, so sessions can fall at different times (Philippine time is the same as China, and Korea is 1 hour ahead).

- We'll confirm your schedule with you before launch

- We will have paid training sessions as well as paid trial sessions (2 hours per week to start - you can get to know us and we can get to know you!) 

- Live sessions start February 1, 2027



PAY

- $10/hour



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word "DRILL" and include:

1. A 60-90 second video introducing yourself in English (tell us about your favorite food)

2. Your weekly availability in Philippine time

3. Your internet speed and equipment

4. Whether you know any Korean



Applications without a video will not be considered.

title: Construction Estimating & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant
description:
JBA PROJECTS

POSITION DESCRIPTION

Construction Estimating & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant



Company: JBA Projects Pty Ltd

Location: Remote - Philippines

Employment: Full-time, 40 hours per week

Remuneration: AUD $8-$12 per hour, depending on experience and capability

Reports to: Director, JBA Projects

Career progression: Long-term opportunities for increased responsibility and advancement



ABOUT JBA PROJECTS



JBA Projects is an Australian construction business focused on delivering quality projects, developing strong client relationships and building efficient systems to support long-term growth.



We are seeking a reliable, ambitious and technically capable Virtual Assistant to join our team on a full-time basis.



This is a varied position combining construction measurement, lead generation, marketing, administration and business operations.



We want someone who takes initiative, enjoys solving problems and can help us build more efficient systems.



This is a long-term career opportunity with genuine potential to progress into a broader business operations role.



1. LEAD GENERATION & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT



Primary responsibility during the initial stages of employment.



Your first major responsibility will be to establish and manage a consistent, scalable lead generation system for JBA Projects.



Key responsibilities include:

- Research builders, developers, contractors and other potential clients.

- Identify business owners, decision-makers and relevant contact details.

- Build and maintain accurate prospect databases.

- Create personalised introductory
s and follow-up sequences.

- Develop and manage outbound
 campaigns.

- Research and implement tools such as Smartlead or similar outreach platforms.

- Use AI to assist with prospect research, personalisation and workflow automation.

- Monitor responses and manage prospect follow-ups.

- Identify qualified opportunities and coordinate appointments.

- Maintain CRM records and track campaign results.

- Protect
 deliverability and follow applicable
 marketing and privacy requirements.

- Document processes and continually improve campaign effectiveness.



Our objective is to establish a system that consistently generates qualified business opportunities, rather than relying indefinitely on manual
 outreach.



Initially, this work will occupy a significant portion of your time.



As the system becomes established and increasingly automated, the manual workload should decrease while lead generation performance is maintained or improved.



This will create opportunities to take on greater responsibility across construction estimating, administration and business operations.



2. CONSTRUCTION ESTIMATING & QUANTITY TAKE-OFFS



Essential technical capability.



You must have demonstrated experience interpreting architectural drawings and completing construction quantity measurements.



A formal quantity surveying qualification is not mandatory. However, practical measurement experience is essential.



Key responsibilities include:

- Read and interpret architectural PDF drawings.

- Understand floor plans, elevations, dimensions and drawing scales.

- Verify drawing scales before taking measurements.

- Accurately measure external building perimeters in linear metres.

- Calculate gross external wall areas in square metres (m²).

- Calculate net external wall areas after specified deductions.

- Identify varying wall heights across different elevations.

- Account for windows, doors and other openings where required.

- Complete quantity take-offs using architectural drawings.

- Prepare accurate measurement spreadsheets and schedules.

- Assist with basic material quantity calculations.

- Identify missing dimensions, discrepancies and drawing inconsistencies.

- Clearly document measurement assumptions and exclusions.

- Assist the Director with basic estimating and quotation preparation.



SPECIFIC TECHNICAL REQUIREMENT



You must be capable of receiving a set of architectural PDF drawings and independently:

1. Identifying and measuring the external building perimeter.

2. Determining relevant external wall heights from plans and elevations.

3. Calculating the total gross external wall area in square metres.

4. Calculating net external wall areas where deductions are specified.

5. Preparing a clear spreadsheet showing measurements, calculations and assumptions.



Experience using Bluebeam Revu, PlanSwift, CostX or similar estimating and PDF measurement software is highly regarded.



Shortlisted applicants will be required to demonstrate their measurement skills through a practical assessment.



3. SOCIAL MEDIA & MARKETING



Assist with maintaining and developing JBA Projects' online presence.



Responsibilities include:

- Prepare and schedule social media posts.

- Write captions for Instagram,
 and 
.

- Create basic graphics and promotional material using Canva.

- Repurpose project photographs, videos and business updates.

- Assist with marketing campaigns and promotional activities.

- Research relevant construction industry content.

- Monitor basic social media enquiries.

- Use AI tools to improve content creation and efficiency.



Advanced graphic design or video editing experience is not essential.



4. XERO & FINANCIAL ADMINISTRATION



Provide basic administrative assistance using Xero accounting software.



Responsibilities may include:

- Prepare draft invoices and quotations for approval.

- Maintain customer and supplier records.

- Organise receipts, invoices and financial documents.

- Assist with accounts receivable administration.

- Prepare payment reminders for outstanding invoices.

- Maintain accurate financial administration records.

- Support the Director and accountant with general tasks.



Previous Xero experience is preferred, although training can be provided.



This is not a qualified accounting position. Financial transactions and approvals remain the responsibility of management.



5. GENERAL ADMINISTRATION & BUSINESS OPERATIONS



Support the Director with a range of administrative and operational activities.



Responsibilities may include:

-
 and inbox management.

- Calendar and appointment coordination.

- Preparing spreadsheets, reports and documents.

- Researching suppliers, subcontractors and business partners.

- Maintaining customer databases and digital records.

- Assisting with customer and supplier correspondence.

- Creating templates, checklists and standard operating procedures.

- Researching and implementing productivity tools.

- Assisting with other reasonable ad hoc tasks as required.



6. SYSTEMS, TECHNOLOGY & AI



We are particularly interested in applicants who enjoy using technology to improve business efficiency.



You will be encouraged to:

- Identify repetitive tasks suitable for automation.

- Research and recommend AI-powered solutions.

- Implement efficient lead generation workflows.

- Improve administrative processes.

- Document repeatable systems and procedures.

- Recommend software that saves time and improves productivity.



Experience with ChatGPT, Smartlead, Make, Zapier or similar platforms is advantageous.



We do not expect expertise in every platform, but you must be comfortable learning new software and applying it to real business problems.



7. ESSENTIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE



Applicants must demonstrate:

- Experience interpreting architectural PDF drawings and completing quantity take-offs.

- Ability to measure external building perimeters and calculate external wall areas accurately.

- Experience with lead generation, prospect research or outbound
 campaigns.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills.

- High attention to detail and accurate record-keeping.

- Strong organisational and time management skills.

- Confidence learning and using AI and business software.

- Ability to manage multiple responsibilities independently.

- A reliable internet connection, suitable computer and professional home working environment.

- A proactive, reliable and accountable attitude.



HIGHLY REGARDED

- Experience working with Australian construction businesses.

- Bluebeam, PlanSwift, CostX or similar estimating software experience.

- Smartlead or other automated outreach platform experience.

- CRM management and automation experience.

- Xero accounting software.

- Canva and social media management.

- Experience working directly with a business owner or Director.



8. CAREER PROGRESSION & DEVELOPMENT



This position is intended to evolve as JBA Projects grows.



INITIAL PHASE - ESTABLISHING SYSTEMS

The early focus will include:

- Developing and implementing a lead generation system.

- Building prospect databases and
 campaigns.

- Introducing practical automation and AI tools.

- Completing construction measurement and take-off tasks as required.

- Learning the company's operations and processes.



DEVELOPMENT PHASE - EXPANDING RESPONSIBILITIES

As lead generation processes become increasingly efficient, responsibilities may expand into:

- Greater involvement in construction estimating.

- More financial and operational administration.

- Managing recurring business processes.

- Coordinating customer and supplier communications.

- Developing systems and operational procedures.



LONG-TERM PROGRESSION

Depending on performance, capabilities and company growth, potential progression opportunities include:

- Senior Virtual Assistant

- Construction Estimating & Administration Coordinator

- Business Operations Coordinator

- Executive Assistant to the Director

- Operations or Administration Manager



These are potential pathways rather than guaranteed promotions.



We are seeking someone who wants to grow professionally and become an increasingly valuable member of JBA Projects over the coming years.



9. PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



Performance will be assessed on results, accuracy, reliability and continuous improvement.



Lead generation:

- Quality and accuracy of prospect databases.

- Consistency and effectiveness of outreach campaigns.

- Qualified leads and opportunities generated.

- Effective follow-up and CRM management.

- Improvements in automation and efficiency.



Construction measurement:

- Accuracy of perimeter and wall area calculations.

- Correct interpretation of architectural drawings.

- Timely completion of quantity take-offs.

- Clear documentation of measurements and assumptions.



Business operations:

- Accuracy and quality of administrative work.

- Ability to complete tasks independently.

- Reliability and responsiveness.

- Initiative and problem-solving.

- Contribution to improving company systems.



Specific performance targets will be agreed during onboarding.



10. WORKING ARRANGEMENTS



Employment: Full-time, 40 hours per week

Location: Remote, Philippines

Hourly rate: AUD $8-$12, depending on experience

Working hours: To be agreed, with suitable overlap with Sydney business hours

Duration: Long-term position

Reporting: Directly to the Director



Remuneration and responsibilities may be reviewed as the employee develops and the business grows.



11. IDEAL CANDIDATE



We are looking for someone who:

- Takes initiative rather than waiting for instructions.

- Has genuine construction measurement capability.

- Understands how to research and approach potential customers.

- Enjoys finding better ways to complete tasks.

- Is willing to learn new skills and technology.

- Can balance technical work with administrative responsibilities.

- Communicates clearly and consistently.

- Takes ownership of their work.

- Works independently without constant supervision.

- Wants to develop a long-term career with a growing company.



WHY JOIN JBA PROJECTS?



This is an opportunity to join an ambitious Australian construction business and work directly with its Director.



You will contribute to business growth, develop valuable technical and operational skills, and help build the systems supporting the company's future.



We value reliability, accountability, initiative, accuracy and continuous improvement.



We're not simply hiring someone to complete tasks. We're looking for someone who wants to help build a stronger business and grow with us.



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



Applicants should provide:

1. An updated CV outlining relevant experience.

2. A short introduction explaining their experience in construction estimating and lead generation.

3. Details of estimating or architectural measurement software they have used.

4. Examples of previous quantity take-off work, with confidential information removed.

5. Details of relevant experience with
 outreach, AI automation, Xero or other business software.

6. Their expected hourly rate in AUD.

7. Their availability to commence full-time employment.



RECRUITMENT ASSESSMENT



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete two practical assessments.



Assessment 1 - Construction Measurement

Using a supplied architectural PDF, calculate the external building perimeter and gross and net external wall areas. Show measurements, calculations and assumptions.



Assessment 2 - Lead Generation

Research five suitable prospective clients, identify relevant decision-makers and prepare a personalised introductory
 with a proposed follow-up approach.



These assessments will help us evaluate practical skills, accuracy, initiative and suitability for the role.



Successful applicants will be invited to interview directly with the Director of JBA Projects.

You will be the primary point of contact between me and prospective brand partners, taking each deal from first outreach through to a fully signed contract. Every two weeks you will receive a list of brands and businesses to pursue, and you will own the process of turning those targets into agreed, signed partnerships.

Outreach and Negotiation

• Review the bi-weekly list of target brands and businesses and begin outreach to each one.

• Negotiate terms for every partnership on the list, including compensation, deliverables, timelines, usage rights, exclusivity, and payment schedules.

• Know when a deal is not a fit, and flag it to me rather than agreeing to unfavorable terms.

Contracts and Signatures

• Once terms are agreed between me and the brand, prepare or obtain a contract that accurately reflects those terms.

• Send the contract to the brand or business and collect their signature first.

•
 the brand-signed contract to me for my review and signature.

• Confirm that a fully executed copy is delivered to both parties and filed in an organized system.

Communication and Reporting

• Keep me updated at every stage of every negotiation, including replies, counteroffers, concerns, and changes in terms.

• Check in with me before agreeing to any major term or deviation from my stated preferences.

• Provide a summary at the end of each two-week cycle showing the status of every brand on the list (pending, negotiating, agreed, signed, declined).

Partnership Management

• Track deliverables, deadlines, and payment dates for all active partnerships.

• Act as the point of contact for brand questions and follow-ups after signing.

• Maintain a record of all brand contacts, terms, and contracts.

Qualifications

• Proven experience in brand partnerships, sponsorships, talent management, sales, or business development.

• Strong negotiation skills with a track record of closing deals.

• Excellent written communication and professional
 etiquette.

• Familiarity with sponsorship contracts and standard terms (exclusivity, usage rights, payment terms, etc.).

• Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple negotiations at once.

• Reliable, responsive, and comfortable working to a bi-weekly cycle.

• Discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information.

Nice to Have

• Experience in the creator, influencer, or media space.

• Experience with CRM or project management tools (Notion, Airtable, Trello, etc.).

• Basic knowledge of contract review and e-signature platforms (DocuSign, PandaDoc, etc.).

What Success Looks Like

• Every brand on the bi-weekly list is contacted and moved toward a clear outcome.

• Agreed terms are accurately captured in signed contracts.

• I am never surprised: I receive timely updates throughout every negotiation.

• Contracts reach me already signed by the brand and ready for my signature.

Compensation

Paid weekly

Contract bonus: You will earn a $20 bonus for every contract that is fully signed and confirmed. Each bonus is added to your following weekly paycheck.

Your mission is to turn raw face-cam reaction recordings into tight, engaging 12-to-25-minute episodes where every cut serves the host's core argument—eliminating filler, reinforcing key points with well-timed memes and sound effects, and delivering scroll-stopping thumbnails.



Key Responsibilities

Tight Pacing & Filler Removal: Ruthlessly cut all dead air, pauses, false starts, stumbles, "ums," "uhs," and repetitive phrasing so the host sounds crisp, authoritative, and natural without feeling overly chopped or robotic.



Story-Driven & Point-Focused Editing: Identify the central thesis and key lessons in every reaction segment. Structure cuts, punch-in zooms, and visual emphasis to spotlight the main points the host is making rather than leaving in tangential rambling.



Tasteful Memes & Sound Effects (SFX): Drop in well-timed reaction memes, pop-culture cutaways, and subtle sound effects to punctuate punchlines, expose double standards, and drive home key points—enhancing retention without over-editing or burying the host's message.



Thumbnail Design & Packaging: Design high-CTR YouTube thumbnails for each episode (combining expressive host face-cam cutouts, recognizable subject reactions from the clip, and bold 2–4 word curiosity hooks) plus optional A/B test variations.



Seamless Reaction Integration & Audio Polish: Balance the source clip (podcasts, debates, courtroom clips) and the host's face-cam commentary smoothly. Normalize dialogue levels, reduce background noise, and maintain consistent vocal clarity across both studio mic audio and external clips.



On-Screen Framework Graphics: Add clean, minimalist lower thirds, chapter markers, and on-screen callouts (such as our 5-point vetting scorecards and rule-of-thumb takeaways) that reinforce the host's points.



Shorts Timestamp Flagging (Bonus): Flag the top 2–3 high-tension moments per episode for vertical Shorts 
 We Are Looking For

Proven Long-Form YouTube & Thumbnail Experience: Strong portfolio of talking-head, podcast, or reaction commentary edits alongside high-performing YouTube thumbnails (familiarity with creators like Mediocre Tutorials and Reviews, Aba & Preach, Taylor the Fiend, or The Roommates is a major plus).



Editorial & Comedic Timing: You listen actively to what the host is saying—you know which sentences carry the weight of the argument and exactly when a 1.5-second meme cut or sound effect makes a point land harder.



Cultural & Niche Alignment: Solid grasp of modern dating discourse, internet meme culture, structured debates, and the tone of constructive masculine self-improvement (grounded, direct, never cheap outrage-bait).



Technical Proficiency: Fast, reliable workflow in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro, plus Photoshop/Canva/Figma for thumbnails, with strong turnaround discipline (48–72 hours per episode + thumbnail).



How to Apply

Send the following with your application:



2–3 links to long-form talking-head or reaction videos you have edited (highlight examples showing tight pacing, clean dialogue cleanup, and tasteful meme/SFX placement).



3–5 sample YouTube thumbnails you have designed (ideally in the commentary, podcast, or reaction space).



Your per-video rate (covering both the 12–25 minute finished edit from 30–45 minutes of raw footage AND the thumbnail) and typical turnaround time.



A 2-sentence note on what makes a reaction video hold viewer retention past the 5-minute mark.

We already have a team of video editors producing 60+ ads a week (AI video, UGC and static ads). What we need now is the brain behind the ads: someone who finds the angles, writes the scripts and briefs, and uses the data to work out what wins.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Write full UGC-style scripts (talking head, founder-style, comparison, reaction, problem/solution) that sound natural to a British audience

- Create new versions of our winning ads (new hooks, new openings, new characters)

- Review weekly performance data (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA) and explain why ads won or lost

- 1–2+ years writing or strategising paid social ads for an ecommerce/DTC brand on Meta or TikTok

- Proof: examples of ads you scripted or briefed, and the results they got

- Excellent written English, with an ear for how UK customers actually talk (no American phrasing)

- Comfortable reading Meta Ads Manager data and turning it into decisions

- Solid direct-response basics: hooks, angles, awareness levels, offers

- Bonus: experience with AI-generated video ads, or with skincare/fragrance/grooming brands



HOW WE WORK

- Remote, full time, Monday to Friday, with a few hours' overlap with UK working hours

- Tools: Notion, Slack, 
, Meta Ads Manager

- You'll work directly with the founder and our creative lead



PAY

- Monthly base salary plus a bonus for every ad that becomes a winner

- Long-term role with room to grow as we scale



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the words "BODY BUTTER" so we know you read this post

2. Send 3 ads you scripted or briefed (links or files) and the results they got

title: Buyer Relationships
description:
In the recording, briefly introduce yourself, then respond as if a buyer just told you, “I’m interested, but I’m too busy to go see it this week. Just send me the details.” Show us what you’d say next.



Real Estate Buyer Relations Specialist | Joe Homebuyer Utah

Joe Homebuyer Utah is hiring a sales-minded Buyer Relations Specialist to build relationships with real estate investors and get qualified buyers out to see the properties we’re selling.



You’ll spend much of your day on the phone. A typical call might start with finding out what an investor buys, move into why a specific property fits their criteria, and end with a confirmed walkthrough. After the showing, you’ll follow up to get feedback and find out whether they’re ready to make an offer.

What you’ll do

- Call, text, and
 investors about available properties.

- Learn each buyer’s preferred locations, budget, property types, and timeline so you can bring them deals that fit.

- Explain property details clearly, handle initial objections, and ask for a specific walkthrough time.

- Confirm appointments, follow up with buyers who miss showings, and get feedback from buyers who attend.

- Keep buyer profiles and next steps current in our CRM. Bring serious buyers and offers to the dispositions team.

- Stay in touch between deals so buyers know who to call when they’re ready for their next property.

What we’re looking for

- Excellent spoken and written English. You can carry a natural phone conversation with U.S. buyers, ask good follow-up questions, and explain details clearly.

- Confidence making outbound calls and asking directly for the next step.

- Strong relationship-building skills and consistent follow-through. Buyers should feel comfortable telling you what they want and why a deal did or didn’t work for them.

- Strong organization and the ability to manage several buyer conversations at once.

- A reliable internet connection, a quiet workspace, and availability to speak with buyers during agreed hours in the U.S. Mountain Time zone.

Experience in phone sales, appointment setting, real estate, or wholesaling is a plus.

How to apply

Use Buyer Relations Specialist – [Your Name] as your application subject line. Include a short summary of your phone sales or customer-facing experience and a link to a 60–90 second voice recording.

We are hiring a part-time Phone and Patient Experience Coordinator to be the warm, polished voice of our practice on the phone. This is a phone-only role focused mainly on our established patients. You will answer every inbound call, book appointments, take clear messages, make callbacks, and handle any task that needs a phone call. You will speak with patients, pharmacies, sales reps, and vendors, so you must be professional with all of them. New-patient booking will move to this role over time.



This is not an entry-level VA role. You need a great phone voice, strong judgment, and a medical office background.



Schedule: 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday (about 20 hours per week). You must be available live for the full shift. Hours may expand as our practice grows.



Call expectation: You answer every inbound call live during your shift. Missed calls are tracked in our phone system's call log.



We are a premium practice and are looking only for top-tier candidates. If you are an average VA, this is not the role for you.



Who This Role Is For

You have:

- A medical office background (front desk, patient coordinator, medical assistant, or similar)

- A great phone voice: strong spoken English, clear and warm, with a professional, confident manner

- Clear, neutral English accent (minimal accent)

- Strong judgment: you know what you can handle and what to pass to the office manager

- 2+ years of customer service or patient-facing phone experience

- The ability to speak professionally with patients, pharmacies, and sales reps alike



Experience in a hormone clinic, wellness clinic, or functional medicine practice is a plus.



You are proactive, detail-oriented, and do not wait to be told what to do. You stay calm with frustrated or confused callers and make them feel cared for.

title: QuickBooks Bookkeeper with US Accounting Experience
description:
Work Setup: 100% Remote (Philippines)

Employment Type: Part-Time

Compensation: Competitive, based on experience



1. Schedule and Communication



Flexible, part-time hours based on assigned bookkeeping tasks and agreed deadlines. Some early morning Eastern Time (New York) availability is required for onboarding and related communication.



Communication includes
 and participation in a WhatsApp group for updates, questions, and feedback. The hourly rate and weekly hour limit will be agreed upon before starting.



2. About the Role



We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented, and experienced QuickBooks Bookkeeper with US accounting experience to support the financial operations of multiple small US-based businesses.



The role includes initial bookkeeping cleanup for two recently launched small businesses, followed by ongoing bookkeeping support. Experience organizing existing records, reconciling prior transactions, and bringing accounts up to date is preferred.



The ideal candidate has strong knowledge of US accounting practices, bookkeeping, and tax reporting requirements, with the ability to work independently, maintain accurate financial records, and provide meaningful financial insights to the business owner.



3. Required Qualifications



a. At least two years of hands-on experience using QuickBooks Online.



b. Solid understanding of US accounting principles, bookkeeping practices, and tax reporting requirements.



c. Experience handling financial records for US-based businesses.



d. Proficiency in bank reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable, journal entries, and financial reporting.



e. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.



f. Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and confidentiality.



g. Strong written and verbal English communication skills.



h. Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and manage priorities while keeping each business’s records separate and organized.



4. Preferred Qualifications



a. QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor Certification.



b. Experience with bookkeeping cleanup and bringing accounts up to date for small businesses or startups.



c. Familiarity with US tax forms and reporting, including W-9, 1099-NEC, and 1099-MISC.



d. Experience in healthcare/physical therapy, real estate, or event-based businesses.



e. Familiarity with Google Workspace, task management tools, and other cloud-based business tools.



f. Ability to identify cost-saving opportunities, improve financial workflows, and proactively recommend solutions.



g. Experience working directly with US business owners or executives.



5. What We’re Looking For



We value someone who goes beyond simply recording transactions. We need a proactive accounting professional who takes ownership of their work, identifies potential issues before they escalate, and helps the owner maintain financial clarity across multiple businesses.



You should be comfortable asking questions, providing recommendations, and communicating financial information clearly.
